38static uint32_t swap32(uint32_t x)
39{
40 return (x >> 24) | ((x >> 8) & 0xff00) | ((x << 8) & 0xff0000) | (x << 24);
41}
42
43static int32_t sx(uint32_t x, unsigned bits)
44{
45 const uint64_t range = uint64_t(1) << bits, sign = range >> 1;
46 const uint64_t v = uint64_t(x) & (range - 1);
47 return static_cast<int32_t>(
48 (v & sign) ? static_cast<int64_t>(v) - static_cast<int64_t>(range)
49 : static_cast<int64_t>(v));
50}
51
52static int64_t fixed_integer(int64_t x)
53{
54 // A DDA's integer portion floors negative fractions; C++ division truncates.
55 return x >= 0 ? x / 65536 : -((-x + 65535) / 65536);
56}
57
58static bool valid_width(unsigned bits)
59{
60 return bits == 8 || bits == 16 || bits == 32;
61}
62
63static uint32_t width_mask(unsigned bits)
64{
65 return bits == 32 ? 0xffffffffu : ((1u << bits) - 1);
66}

68static bool host_tag(uint32_t a)
69{
70 return a == CPermedia2::FBData || a == CPermedia2::FBSourceData ||
71 a == CPermedia2::Color || a == CPermedia2::Depth ||
72 a == CPermedia2::Stencil || a == CPermedia2::Texel0;
73}

75static float vertex_float(uint32_t bits)
76{
77 float value;
78 static_assert(sizeof(value) == sizeof(bits), "IEEE vertex word size");
79 std::memcpy(&value, &bits, sizeof(value));
80 return value;
81}

83static uint32_t vertex_bits(float value)
84{
85 uint32_t bits;
86 std::memcpy(&bits, &value, sizeof(bits));
87 return bits;
88}

90// Register dispatch and indexed RAMDAC registers
91
92// MMIO and queued graphics commands share the hardware's 8-byte register
93// spacing. WriteMem enqueues graphics writes; service invokes their handlers
94// only when each command reaches the FIFO head.
95uint32_t CPermedia2::register_read(uint32_t address)
96{
97 if (address >= FIFO && address < 0x3000)
98 {
99 if (r(OutDMACount))
100 {
101 // Slave reads must not compete with an active PCI output transfer.
102 signal_error(1u << 8);
103 report(
104 "OUTPUT_DMA_ACCESS",
105 address,
106 0,
107 "CPU output FIFO access while output DMA is active");
108 return 0;
109 }
110 if (m_output.empty())
111 {
112 signal_error(1u << 1);
113 report(
114 "EMPTY_OUTPUT",
115 address,
116 0,
117 "Read from empty output FIFO; returned modeled open-bus zero");
118 return 0;
119 }
120 const uint32_t value = m_output.front().value;
121 m_output.pop_front();
122 update_irq();
123 return value;
124 }
125 switch (address)
126 {
127 case InFIFOSpace:
128 return m_options.input_fifo_entries -
129 static_cast<uint32_t>(m_input.size());
130 case OutFIFOWords:
131 return static_cast<uint32_t>(m_output.size());
132 case FIFODiscon:
133 return (r(FIFODiscon) & 0x7fffffffu) | (busy() ? 0x80000000u : 0);
134 case DisplayData:
135 return (r(DisplayData) & 12u) |
136 3u; // No EDID device; pulled-up data/clock.
137 case Reboot:
138 return 0;
139 case TexelLUTIndex:
140 // The write index and the sequential readback counter are independent.
141 m_texel_lut_read = 0;
142 return r(TexelLUTIndex);
143 case TexelLUTData:
144 {
145 const uint32_t value = m_texel_lut[m_texel_lut_read];
146 m_texel_lut_read = (m_texel_lut_read + 1) & 255;
147 return value;
148 }
149 case PaletteWrite:
150 return m_palette_w / 3;
151 case PaletteRead:
152 return m_palette_r / 3;
153 case PaletteData:
154 {
155 const uint8_t value = m_palette[m_palette_r];
156 m_palette_r = (m_palette_r + 1) % 768;
157 return value;
158 }
159 case IndexedData:
160 return m_dac_map.read_byte(r(PaletteWrite) & 255);
161 case CursorColorData:
162 {
163 const uint8_t value = m_cursor_colors[m_cursor_color_pos];
164 m_cursor_color_pos = (m_cursor_color_pos + 1) % 12;
165 return value;
166 }
167 case CursorRAM:
168 {
169 const uint8_t value = m_cursor[m_cursor_pos];
170 m_cursor_pos = (m_cursor_pos + 1) % 1024;
171 return value;
172 }
173 default:
174 unknown_register(address, 0, false);
175 return r(address);
176 }
177}

179bool CPermedia2::register_write(uint32_t address, uint32_t value)
180{
181 if (address >= FIFO && address < 0x3000)
182 return packet_word(value);
183 if (address >= TexelLUT0 && address < TexelLUT0 + 16 * 8)
184 {
185 m_texel_lut[(address - TexelLUT0) / 8] = value;
186 r(address) = value;
187 return true;
188 }
189 if (address >= V0Fixed && address < DeltaMode &&
190 vertex_write(address, value))
191 return true;
192 switch (address)
193 {
194 case ResetStatus:
195 reset();
196 return true;
197 case IntEnable:
198 r(IntEnable) = value;
199 update_irq();
200 return true;
201 case IntFlags:
202 r(IntFlags) &= ~value;
203 update_irq();
204 return true;
205 case ErrorFlags:
206 r(ErrorFlags) &= ~value;
207 return true;
208 case InFIFOSpace:
209 case OutFIFOWords:
210 case LineCount:
211 case Count:
212 return false;
213 case DMAAddress:
214 if (r(DMACount))
215 {
216 report(
217 "DMA_BUSY",
218 DMAAddress,
219 value,
220 "DMA address changed while active",
221 true);
222 return false;
223 }
224 r(DMAAddress) = value & ~3u;
225 m_dma_cursor = r(DMAAddress);
226 return true;
227 case DMACount:
228 if (r(DMACount))
229 {
230 report(
231 "DMA_BUSY",
232 DMACount,
233 value,
234 "DMA restarted while active",
235 true);
236 return false;
237 }
238 if ((value & 0xffff) != 0 && (r(DMAControl) & ~0x10u) != 0)
239 {
240 report(
241 "DMA_MODE",
242 DMACount,
243 value,
244 "Only untransformed input DMA is implemented",
245 true);
246 return false;
247 }
248 r(DMACount) = value & 0xffff;
249 m_dma_cursor = r(DMAAddress);
250 return true;
251 case OutDMACount:
252 if (r(OutDMACount))
253 {
254 signal_error(1u << 10);
255 report(
256 "OUTPUT_DMA_BUSY",
257 OutDMACount,
258 value,
259 "Output DMA count rewritten while active",
260 true);
261 return false;
262 }
263 // The readable address remains the last programmed start, including
264 // when software prepares the next transfer while this one runs.
265 r(OutDMACount) = value & 0xffff;
266 m_out_dma_cursor = r(OutDMAAddress);
267 return true;
268 case ScreenBase:
269 r(ScreenBase) = value & 0x1fffffu;
270 if (r(VideoControl) & 1)
271 r(VideoControl) |= 0x80;
272 else
273 m_active_screen_base = r(ScreenBase);
274 return true;
275 case VideoControl:
276 r(VideoControl) = (value & ~0x80u) | (r(VideoControl) & 0x80u);
277 return true;
278 case Reboot:
279 // SGRAM mode reload completes synchronously; it does not reset
280 // graphics state or execute option-ROM firmware.
281 r(Reboot) = 0;
282 return true;
283 case MemControl:
284 r(MemControl) = value & 0x10u;
285 return true;
286 case BootAddress:
287 r(BootAddress) = value & 0x3ffu;
288 return true;
289 case VClkCtl:
290 r(VClkCtl) = value & 0x3ffu;
291 return true;
292 case FifoControl:
293 // Threshold fields are RW; UNDERFLOW is write-one-to-clear.
294 r(FifoControl) =
295 (value & 0x1f1fu) | ((r(FifoControl) & 0x10000u) & ~value);
296 return true;
297 case VSConfiguration:
298 if ((value & 7u) >= 1 && (value & 7u) <= 4)
299 {
300 report(
301 "VIDEO_STREAM_MODE",
302 VSConfiguration,
303 value,
304 "Active video-stream/GPBus modes are not implemented",
305 true);
306 return false;
307 }
308 r(VSConfiguration) = value & 0x1fffffffu;
309 return true;
310 case Sync:
311 {
312 const unsigned mode = (r(FilterMode) >> 10) & 3;
313 const size_t words = ((mode & 1) ? 1u : 0u) + ((mode & 2) ? 1u : 0u);
314 if (m_output.size() + words > 8)
315 return false;
316 bool intr = (value & 0x80000000u) != 0;
317 if (mode & 1)
318 {
319 output_push(tag(Sync), intr);
320 intr = false;
321 }
322 if (mode & 2)
323 output_push(value, intr);
324 r(Sync) = value;
325 return true;
326 }
327 case SuspendUntilFrameBlank:
328 m_waiting_frame = true;
329 m_wait_frame = m_frame_number + 1;
330 r(SuspendUntilFrameBlank) = value;
331 return true;
332 case DrawTriangle:
333 r(DrawTriangle) = value;
334 draw_triangle(value);
335 return true;
336 case RepeatTriangle:
337 case DrawLine01:
338 case DrawLine10:
339 case RepeatLine:
340 report(
341 "UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND",
342 address,
343 value,
344 "Setup-unit command not implemented",
345 true);
346 return true;
347 case Continue:
348 case ContinueNewLine:
349 case ContinueNewDom:
350 case ContinueNewSub:
351 r(address) = value;
352 continue_render(address, value);
353 return true;
354 case Config:
355 r(FBReadMode) =
356 (r(FBReadMode) & ~(ReadSource | ReadDestination | Packed)) |
357 ((value & 1) ? ReadSource : 0) |
358 ((value & 2) ? ReadDestination : 0) | ((value & 4) ? Packed : 0);
359 r(FBWriteMode) = (r(FBWriteMode) & ~1u) | ((value >> 3) & 1);
360 r(ColorDDAMode) = (r(ColorDDAMode) & ~1u) | ((value >> 4) & 1);
361 r(LogicalOpMode) = (r(LogicalOpMode) & ~31u) | ((value >> 5) & 31);
362 r(Config) = value;
363 return true;
364 case FBReadMode:
365 r(FBWriteConfig) = value;
366 m_relative_offset = sx(value >> 20, 3);
367 r(FBReadMode) = value;
368 return true;
369 case PackedDataLimits:
370 m_relative_offset = sx(value >> 29, 3);
371 r(FBReadMode) = (r(FBReadMode) & ~0x700000u) |
372 (uint32_t(m_relative_offset & 7) << 20);
373 r(PackedDataLimits) = value;
374 return true;
375 case FBWindowBase:
376 r(FBSourceBase) = r(FBWindowBase) = value;
377 return true;
378 case FBSourceDelta:
379 {
380 const int64_t origin_sign = (r(FBReadMode) & 0x10000) ? -1 : 1;
381 const int64_t delta = int64_t(sx(value >> 16, 12)) *
382 pitch_from_products(r(FBReadMode)) * origin_sign +
383 sx(value, 12);
384 r(FBSourceOffset) = uint32_t(delta) & 0xffffff;
385 r(FBSourceDelta) = value;
386 return true;
387 }
388 case TextureDownloadOffset:
389 r(TextureDownloadOffset) = value & 0x3fffffu;
390 return true;
391 case TexelLUTIndex:
392 r(TexelLUTIndex) = value & 255;
393 return true;
394 case TexelLUTData:
395 {
396 const uint32_t index = r(TexelLUTIndex);
397 m_texel_lut[index] = value;
398 if (index < 16)
399 r(TexelLUT0 + index * 8) = value;
400 r(TexelLUTData) = value;
401 r(TexelLUTIndex) = (index + 1) & 255;
402 return true;
403 }
404 case TexelLUTTransfer:
405 // Count is the number of LUT entries (SLAU011A, pp. 4-60/7-146).
406 // A zero count changes no table, index or address and reads no memory.
407 // Older PM2 documentation includes bit 16 in Count; keep it unsupported.
408 if ((value & 0x1ff00u) == 0)
409 {
410 r(TexelLUTTransfer) = value;
411 return true;
412 }
413 // Fall through for unsupported nonempty transfers.
414 case TexelLUTID:
415 report("TEXTURE_LUT_TRANSFER", address, value,
416 "Texture LUT memory transfers are not implemented", true);
417 return true;
418 case FBBlockColor:
419 // The convenience register loads both halves of the SGRAM pattern.
420 r(FBBlockColor) = r(FBBlockColorL) = r(FBBlockColorU) = value;
421 return true;
422 case TextureData:
423 {
424 const uint32_t offset = r(TextureDownloadOffset) & 0x3fffffu;
425 const uint32_t destination = offset * 4;
426 // Raw downloads bypass the rendering pipeline and FBWriteMode, but
427 // retain the framebuffer's hardware write protection (SLAU011A,
428 // sections 4.11.6/4.11.7; hardware reference section 3.3.6).
429 if (destination >= VramSize && !m_warned[TextureDownloadOffset / 8])
430 {
431 m_warned[TextureDownloadOffset / 8] = true;
432 report(
433 "TEXTURE_DOWNLOAD_RANGE",
434 TextureDownloadOffset,
435 offset,
436 "Out-of-VRAM texture data discarded; electrical aliasing "
437 "unmodeled");
438 }
439 pixel_write(destination, 4, value, 0xffffffffu, r(FBHardwareWriteMask));
440 r(TextureData) = value;
441 r(TextureDownloadOffset) = (offset + 1) & 0x3fffffu;
442 return true;
443 }
444 case Render:
445 r(Render) = value;
446 start_render(value);
447 return true;
448 case FBData:
449 case FBSourceData:
450 case BitMaskPattern:
451 r(address) = value;
452 report(
453 "ORPHAN_PAYLOAD",
454 address,
455 value,
456 "Host data outside a waiting Render is retained, not drawn");
457 return true;
458 // Direct RAMDAC ports retain byte semantics even for a PCI DWORD transfer.
459 case PaletteWrite:
460 {
461 const uint8_t v = static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
462 m_palette_w = uint32_t(v) * 3;
463 r(PaletteWrite) = v;
464 m_cursor_pos = ((m_dac[DACCursorControl] >> 2) & 3) * 256 + v;
465 return true;
466 }
467 case PaletteRead:
468 {
469 const uint8_t v = static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
470 m_palette_r = uint32_t(v) * 3;
471 r(PaletteRead) = v;
472 return true;
473 }
474 case PaletteData:
475 m_palette[m_palette_w] = static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
476 m_palette_w = (m_palette_w + 1) % 768;
477 r(PaletteWrite) = m_palette_w / 3;
478 return true;
479 case IndexedData:
480 m_dac_map.write_byte(
481 r(PaletteWrite) & 255, static_cast<uint8_t>(value));
482 return true;
483 case CursorColorAddress:
484 m_cursor_color_pos = (value % 4) * 3;
485 r(CursorColorAddress) = value;
486 return true;
487 case CursorColorData:
488 m_cursor_colors[m_cursor_color_pos] = static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
489 m_cursor_color_pos = (m_cursor_color_pos + 1) % 12;
490 return true;
491 case CursorRAM:
492 m_cursor[m_cursor_pos] = static_cast<uint8_t>(value);
493 m_cursor_pos = (m_cursor_pos + 1) % 1024;
494 r(PaletteWrite) = m_cursor_pos & 255;
495 m_palette_w = (m_cursor_pos & 255) * 3;
496 m_dac[DACCursorControl] = uint8_t(
497 (m_dac[DACCursorControl] & ~12u) | ((m_cursor_pos >> 6) & 12));
498 return true;
499 default:
500 unknown_register(address, value, true);
501 r(address) = value;
502 return true;
503 }
504}

506// Indexed RAMDAC registers use the same byte address_map as the VGA CRTC.
507void CPermedia2::dac_map(address_map& map)
508{
509 map(0, 255).lrw8(
510 NAME([this](offs_t offset) {
511 return m_dac[offset];
512 }),
513 NAME([this](offs_t offset, uint8_t value) {
514 m_dac[offset] = value;
515 }));
516 map(DACCursorControl, DACCursorControl)
517 .lw8(NAME([this](offs_t, uint8_t value) {
518 m_dac[DACCursorControl] = value;
519 m_cursor_pos = ((value >> 2) & 3) * 256 + (r(PaletteWrite) & 255);
520 }));
521 map(0x20, 0x28).lw8(NAME([this](offs_t offset, uint8_t value) {
522 const unsigned index = 0x20 + offset;
523 const unsigned base = 0x20 + (offset / 3) * 3;
524 m_dac[index] = value;
525 m_dac[DACPixelClockStatus] = (m_dac[base + 2] & 8) ? 0x10 : 0;
526 }));
527 map(0x30, 0x32).lw8(NAME([this](offs_t offset, uint8_t value) {
528 m_dac[0x30 + offset] = value;
529 m_dac[DACMemoryClockStatus] = (m_dac[0x32] & 8) ? 0x10 : 0;
530 }));
531 // Lock status follows an enabled programmed clock and is read-only.
532 map(DACPixelClockStatus, DACPixelClockStatus).lw8(NAME([](offs_t, uint8_t) {
533 }));
534 map(DACMemoryClockStatus, DACMemoryClockStatus)
535 .lw8(NAME([](offs_t, uint8_t) {
536 }));
537}

539// Registers absent from register_name() have no modeled behavior.
540void CPermedia2::unknown_register(uint32_t a, uint32_t value, bool write)
541{
542 if (m_unknown_reported[a / 8] || std::strcmp(register_name(a), "REGISTER"))
543 return;
544 m_unknown_reported[a / 8] = true;
545 if (m_unimplemented)
546 m_unimplemented("Permedia2 register", a, value, write);
547}

549const char* CPermedia2::register_name(uint32_t a)
550{
551 if (a >= V0Fixed && a < DeltaMode)
552 {
553 static const char* const names[3][16] = {
554 { "V0S", "V0T", "V0Q", "V0Ks", "V0Kd", "V0R", "V0G", "V0B",
555 "V0A", "V0F", "V0X", "V0Y", "V0Z", "REGISTER", "V0Color", "REGISTER" },
556 { "V1S", "V1T", "V1Q", "V1Ks", "V1Kd", "V1R", "V1G", "V1B",
557 "V1A", "V1F", "V1X", "V1Y", "V1Z", "REGISTER", "V1Color", "REGISTER" },
558 { "V2S", "V2T", "V2Q", "V2Ks", "V2Kd", "V2R", "V2G", "V2B",
559 "V2A", "V2F", "V2X", "V2Y", "V2Z", "REGISTER", "V2Color", "REGISTER" }
560 };
561 const unsigned vertex = ((a - V0Fixed) / 0x80) % 3;
562 return names[vertex][((a - V0Fixed) / 8) & 15];
563 }
564 if ((a & 0xffff) >= TexelLUT0 && (a & 0xffff) < TexelLUT0 + 16 * 8)
565 {
566 static const char* const names[16] = {
567 "TexelLUT0", "TexelLUT1", "TexelLUT2", "TexelLUT3",
568 "TexelLUT4", "TexelLUT5", "TexelLUT6", "TexelLUT7",
569 "TexelLUT8", "TexelLUT9", "TexelLUT10", "TexelLUT11",
570 "TexelLUT12", "TexelLUT13", "TexelLUT14", "TexelLUT15"};
571 return names[((a & 0xffff) - TexelLUT0) / 8];
572 }
573 switch (a & 0xffff)
574 {
575#define R(x) \
576 case x: \
577 return #x;

711 R(Window);
712 R(ZStartU);
713 R(ZStartL);
714 R(dZdxU);
715 R(dZdxL);
716 R(dZdyDomU);
717 R(dZdyDomL);
718 R(LBWriteMode);
719 R(TextureData);
720 R(TextureDownloadOffset);
721 R(StencilMode);
722 R(DepthMode);
723 R(FBReadMode);
724 R(FBSourceOffset);
725 R(FBPixelOffset);
726 R(FBColor);
727 R(FBData);
728 R(FBSourceData);
729 R(FBWindowBase);
730 R(FBWriteMode);
731 R(FBHardwareWriteMask);
732 R(FBBlockColor);
733 R(FBBlockColorU);
734 R(FBBlockColorL);
735 R(FBReadPixel);
736 R(FBWriteConfig);
737 R(FilterMode);
738 R(StatisticMode);

740 R(SuspendUntilFrameBlank);

756
757uint32_t CPermedia2::ReadMem(uint32_t a, int dsize)
758{
759 if (!valid_width(dsize) || a >= RegisterBARSize || (a & (dsize / 8 - 1)))
760 {
761 report("ACCESS_WIDTH", a, dsize, "Invalid MMIO width or alignment");
762 return 0xffffffffu;
763 }
764 const bool swap = (a & 0x10000) != 0;
765 a &= 0xffff;
766 if (swap && dsize != 32)
767 {
768 report(
769 "SWAP_SUBWORD",
770 a,
771 dsize,
772 "Subword upper MMIO alias not implemented");
773 return width_mask(dsize);
774 }
775 if (a >= 0x5000 && a < 0x8000 && (a != VSConfiguration || swap))
776 {
777 report(
778 "UNIMPLEMENTED_WINDOW",
779 a,
780 0,
781 "Video streams, VGA proxy and reserved windows are not "
782 "implemented");
783 return width_mask(dsize);
784 }
785 if (a >= 0x2000 && a < 0x3000)
786 {
787 if (dsize != 32)
788 {
789 report("FIFO_WIDTH", a, dsize, "FIFO requires a 32-bit access");
790 return width_mask(dsize);
791 }
792 }
793 else if ((a & 7) != 0 || (dsize != 32 && !(a >= 0x4000 && a < 0x5000)))
794 {
795 report(
796 "REGISTER_HOLE",
797 a,
798 dsize,
799 "Unsupported register lane; no register alias or side effect");
800 return width_mask(dsize);
801 }
802 uint32_t value = register_read(a);
803 if (a >= 0x4000 && a < 0x5000)
804 value &= 255;
805 if (a >= 0x8000 && !m_warned[a / 8])
806 {
807 m_warned[a / 8] = true;
808 report(
809 "SHADOW_READ",
810 a,
811 value,
812 "GP read returns modeled state, not verified hardware readback");
813 }
814 if (swap)
815 value = swap32(value);
816 return value & width_mask(dsize);
817}
818
819bool CPermedia2::WriteMem(uint32_t a, int dsize, uint32_t data)
820{
821 if (!valid_width(dsize) || a >= RegisterBARSize || (a & (dsize / 8 - 1)))
822 {
823 report("ACCESS_WIDTH", a, dsize, "Invalid MMIO width or alignment");
824 return false;
825 }
826 const bool swap = (a & 0x10000) != 0;
827 a &= 0xffff;
828 if (a >= 0x5000 && a < 0x8000 && (a != VSConfiguration || swap))
829 {
830 report(
831 "UNIMPLEMENTED_WINDOW",
832 a,
833 data,
834 "Video-stream/VGA window write not implemented",
835 true);
836 return false;
837 }
838 if (swap)
839 {
840 if (dsize != 32)
841 {
842 report(
843 "SWAP_SUBWORD",
844 a,
845 data,
846 "Subword upper MMIO alias not implemented");
847 return false;
848 }
849 data = swap32(data);
850 }
851 if (a >= 0x2000 && a < 0x3000)
852 {
853 if (dsize != 32)
854 {
855 report("FIFO_WIDTH", a, dsize, "FIFO requires a 32-bit access");
856 return false;
857 }
858 return register_write(a, data);
859 }
860 if ((a & 7) != 0 || (dsize != 32 && !(a >= 0x4000 && a < 0x5000)))
861 {
862 report(
863 "REGISTER_HOLE",
864 a,
865 data,
866 "Ignored non-register lane; especially GP +4 is not an alias");
867 return false;
868 }
869 if (a >= 0x8000)
870 {
871 if (m_input.size() == m_options.input_fifo_entries)
872 {
873 report(
874 "INPUT_FULL",
875 a,
876 data,
877 "Input FIFO full; write was not accepted");
878 return false;
879 }
880 m_input.push_back({a, data});
881 return true;
882 }
883 if (a >= 0x4000 && a < 0x5000)
884 data &= 255;
885 return register_write(a, data);
886}
887
888uint32_t CPermedia2::peek(uint32_t a) const
889{
890 if (a >= 0x10000 || (a & 7))
891 throw std::out_of_range("unaligned canonical register");
892 return r(a);
893}
894
895uint32_t CPermedia2::mem_read(unsigned ap, uint32_t a, int dsize)
896{
897 if (ap > 1 || !valid_width(dsize) || a > VramSize - dsize / 8)
898 {
899 report(
900 "APERTURE_RANGE", a, dsize, "Invalid framebuffer aperture access");
901 return 0xffffffff;
902 }
903 const uint32_t mode = r(ap ? ApertureTwo : ApertureOne);
904 if (mode == 0x200)
905 {
906 // Only plain ROM routing is implemented. Combined formatting modes
907 // are deliberately rejected pending a matching-device test.
908 uint32_t v = 0;
909 for (unsigned i = 0; i < static_cast<unsigned>(dsize) / 8; ++i)
910 v |= uint32_t(m_rom_reader ? m_rom_reader((a + i) & 0xffffu) : 0xff)
911 << (i * 8);
912 return v;
913 }
914 if ((mode & ~3u) || (mode & 3u) == 3)
915 {
916 report(
917 "APERTURE_MODE",
918 a,
919 mode,
920 "Reserved/packed/SVGA/combined aperture mode is not implemented",
921 true);
922 return width_mask(dsize);
923 }
924 const unsigned lane = (mode == 1) ? 3u : (mode == 2) ? 2u : 0u;
925 uint32_t v = 0;
926 for (unsigned i = 0; i < static_cast<unsigned>(dsize) / 8; ++i)
927 v |= uint32_t(m_vram[(a + i) ^ lane]) << (i * 8);
928 return v;
929}
930
931void CPermedia2::mem_write(unsigned ap, uint32_t a, int dsize, uint32_t data)
932{
933 if (ap > 1 || !valid_width(dsize) || a > VramSize - dsize / 8)
934 {
935 report(
936 "APERTURE_RANGE", a, data, "Invalid framebuffer aperture access");
937 return;
938 }
939 const uint32_t mode = r(ap ? ApertureTwo : ApertureOne);
940 if (mode == 0x200)
941 {
942 report(
943 "ROM_READ_ONLY",
944 a,
945 data,
946 "ROM programming not implemented; no VRAM or firmware "
947 "modification");
948 return;
949 }
950 if ((mode & ~3u) || (mode & 3u) == 3)
951 {
952 report(
953 "APERTURE_MODE",
954 a,
955 mode,
956 "Reserved/packed/SVGA/combined aperture mode is not implemented",
957 true);
958 return;
959 }
960 const unsigned lane = (mode == 1) ? 3u : (mode == 2) ? 2u : 0u;
961 for (unsigned i = 0; i < static_cast<unsigned>(dsize) / 8; ++i)
962 {
963 const uint32_t address = (a + i) ^ lane;
964 const uint8_t mask = uint8_t(r(BypassWriteMask) >> ((address & 3) * 8));
965 m_vram[address] =
966 uint8_t((m_vram[address] & ~mask) | ((data >> (i * 8)) & mask));
967 }
968}
969
970// Command processing and interrupts
971
972bool CPermedia2::packet_word(uint32_t value)
973{
974 if (m_decoder.remaining == 0)
975 {
976 const uint32_t mode = (value >> 14) & 3;
977 // Delta vertex/setup registers occupy groups 0x20..0x26, requiring
978 // ten-bit tags (SLAU011A, Table 8-1), despite the nine-bit
979 // description in section 2.3.4. Bits 10..13 remain reserved.
980 if (mode == 3 || (value & 0x3c00u))
981 {
982 report(
983 "FIFO_PACKET",
984 FIFO,
985 value,
986 "Reserved FIFO packet format",
987 true);
988 return false;
989 }
990 m_decoder.mode = mode;
991 m_decoder.tag = value & 0x3ff;
992 m_decoder.mask = value >> 16;
993 if (mode == 2)
994 {
995 m_decoder.tag &= 0x3f0;
996 m_decoder.remaining = 0;
997 for (uint32_t m = m_decoder.mask; m; m >>= 1)
998 m_decoder.remaining += m & 1;
999 }
1000 else
1001 m_decoder.remaining = (value >> 16) + 1;
1002 return true;
1003 }
1004 if (m_input.size() == m_options.input_fifo_entries)
1005 {
1006 report(
1007 "INPUT_FULL",
1008 FIFO,
1009 value,
1010 "Formatted FIFO data not accepted; decoder remains unchanged");
1011 return false;
1012 }
1013 uint32_t tagv = m_decoder.tag;
1014 if (m_decoder.mode == 2)
1015 {
1016 unsigned bit = 0;
1017 while (((m_decoder.mask >> bit) & 1) == 0 && bit < 16)
1018 ++bit;
1019 tagv += bit;
1020 m_decoder.mask &= ~(1u << bit);
1021 }
1022 m_input.push_back({0x8000 + tagv * 8, value});
1023 --m_decoder.remaining;
1024 if (m_decoder.mode == 1)
1025 m_decoder.tag = (m_decoder.tag + 1) & 0x3ff;
1026 return true;
1027}
1028
1029bool CPermedia2::execute(const Command& c)
1030{
1031 const uint32_t a = c.address, v = c.value;
1032 if (!register_write(a, v))
1033 return false;
1034 if (register_name(a) == std::string("REGISTER") && !m_warned[a / 8])
1035 {
1036 m_warned[a / 8] = true;
1037 report(
1038 "STATE_SHADOW",
1039 a,
1040 v,
1041 "State write retained; inspect capability documentation before "
1042 "assuming functional "
1043 "support");
1044 }
1045 // Unrecognized state writes are retained for trace/readback, not evidence of
1046 // support. Known non-2D modes are checked when a Render consumes state.
1047 return true;
1048}
1049
1050void CPermedia2::output_push(uint32_t value, bool interrupt)
1051{
1052 if (m_output.size() >= 8)
1053 throw std::logic_error("output capacity invariant");
1054 m_output.push_back({value, interrupt});
1055 update_irq();
1056}
1057
1058void CPermedia2::signal_error(uint32_t flags)
1059{
1060 r(ErrorFlags) |= flags;
1061 r(IntFlags) |= IRQ_ERROR;
1062 update_irq();
1063}
1064
1065void CPermedia2::update_irq()
1066{
1067 if (!m_output.empty() && m_output.front().interrupt)
1068 {
1069 r(IntFlags) |= IRQ_SYNC;
1070 m_output.front().interrupt =
1071 false; // latch once on arrival at FIFO HEAD
1072 }
1073 const bool level = (r(IntFlags) & r(IntEnable)) != 0;
1074 if (level != m_irq)
1075 {
1076 m_irq = level;
1077 if (m_irq_callback)
1078 m_irq_callback(m_irq);
1079 }
1080}
1081
1082bool CPermedia2::busy() const
1083{
1084 return m_job.active || !m_input.empty() || r(DMACount) != 0 ||
1085 r(OutDMACount) != 0 || m_waiting_frame;
1086}
1087
1088size_t CPermedia2::service(size_t budget)
1089{
1090 size_t used = 0;
1091 while (used < budget && !m_halted)
1092 {
1093 bool progress = false;
1094 if (m_waiting_frame && m_frame_number >= m_wait_frame)
1095 m_waiting_frame = false;
1096 if (!m_waiting_frame)
1097 {
1098 if (m_job.active)
1099 progress = draw_step();
1100 else if (!m_input.empty())
1101 {
1102 const Command cmd = m_input.front();
1103 if (execute(cmd))
1104 {
1105 m_input.pop_front();
1106 progress = true;
1107 }
1108 }
1109 }
1110 if (m_halted)
1111 break;
1112 // Drain at most one output word per quantum, even while graphics is
1113 // blocked by a full output FIFO. Commit progress only after the PCI
1114 // callback succeeds, preserving the exact pending word on failure.
1115 if (r(OutDMACount) && !m_output.empty())
1116 {
1117 const uint32_t value = m_output.front().value;
1118 uint8_t b[4];
1119 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
1120 b[i] = uint8_t(
1121 value >> (8 * ((r(DMAControl) & 0x10) ? 3 - i : i)));
1122 if (m_out_dma_cursor > UINT32_MAX - 3 || !m_dma_writer ||
1123 !m_dma_writer(m_out_dma_cursor, b, sizeof(b)))
1124 {
1125 signal_error(1u << 7);
1126 report(
1127 "DMA_WRITE",
1128 m_out_dma_cursor,
1129 4,
1130 "PCI DMA writer failed or bus mastering disabled",
1131 true);
1132 break;
1133 }
1134 m_output.pop_front();
1135 m_out_dma_cursor += 4;
1136 --r(OutDMACount);
1137 update_irq();
1138 // Output completion is polled through OutDMACount. The documented
1139 // DMA interrupt belongs to input DMA; Sync-at-head is independent.
1140 progress = true;
1141 }
1142 // Fetch at most one DMA word per scheduling quantum. Execution can stall
1143 // on payload/output space without preventing pending payload DMA arrival.
1144 if (r(DMACount) && m_input.size() < m_options.input_fifo_entries)
1145 {
1146 uint8_t b[4]{};
1147 if (!m_dma_reader || !m_dma_reader(m_dma_cursor, b, 4))
1148 {
1149 report(
1150 "DMA_READ",
1151 m_dma_cursor,
1152 4,
1153 "PCI DMA reader failed or bus mastering disabled",
1154 true);
1155 break;
1156 }
1157 const uint32_t value = uint32_t(b[0]) | (uint32_t(b[1]) << 8) |
1158 (uint32_t(b[2]) << 16) | (uint32_t(b[3]) << 24);
1159 if (!packet_word(value))
1160 break;
1161 m_dma_cursor += 4;
1162 --r(DMACount);
1163 progress = true;
1164 if (r(DMACount) == 0)
1165 {
1166 r(IntFlags) |= IRQ_DMA;
1167 update_irq();
1168 }
1169 }
1170 if (!progress)
1171 break;
1172 ++r(Count);
1173 ++used;
1174 }
1175 return used;
1176}
1177
1178// Rasterizer and framebuffer
1179
1180uint32_t CPermedia2::pitch_from_products(uint32_t mode)
1181{
1182 uint32_t out = 0;
1183 for (unsigned shift = 0; shift < 9; shift += 3)
1184 {
1185 const uint32_t p = (mode >> shift) & 7;
1186 if (p)
1187 out += 1u << (p + 4);
1188 }
1189 return out;
1190}
1191
1192unsigned CPermedia2::render_bytes() const
1193{
1194 switch (r(FBReadPixel) & 7)
1195 {
1196 case 0:
1197 return 1;
1198 case 1:
1199 return 2;
1200 case 2:
1201 return 4;
1202 case 4:
1203 return 3;
1204 default:
1205 return 0;
1206 }
1207}
1208
1209unsigned CPermedia2::texture_bytes() const
1210{
1211 switch ((r(TextureMapFormat) >> 19) & 7)
1212 {
1213 case 0:
1214 return 1;
1215 case 1:
1216 return 2;
1217 case 2:
1218 return 4;
1219 case 4:
1220 return 3;
1221 default:
1222 return 0;
1223 }
1224}
1225
1226bool CPermedia2::validate_texture_block(uint32_t value)
1227{
1228 if ((r(TextureLUTMode) & 3) == 3)
1229 {
1230 // Direct indexing supplies a raw SGRAM pattern at each scanline start;
1231 // it does not use the texture-memory enable, address DDAs or format.
1232 // Bound the LUT's 8-pixel row layout to the native framebuffer width.
1233 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
1234 const unsigned pixels = (r(TextureLUTMode) >> 10) & 3;
1235 if ((r(TextureLUTMode) & ~0xfffu) || pixels == 3 ||
1236 (bytes != 1 && bytes != 2 && bytes != 4) ||
1237 (1u << pixels) * bytes != 4 ||
1238 (r(TextureColorMode) & 15) != 7 || (r(TextureColorMode) & ~15u) ||
1239 (value & (SyncHost | SyncMask)) ||
1240 ((value & 1) && (r(AreaStippleMode) & 0x100001) == 0x100001) ||
1241 ((value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveRectangle &&
1242 (value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveTrapezoid))
1243 {
1244 report("TEXTURE_LUT_BLOCK_MODE", TextureLUTMode, r(TextureLUTMode),
1245 "Direct-index block fills require native 8/16/32-bit pixels, "
1246 "matching LUT pixels per entry and texture-copy application",
1247 true);
1248 return false;
1249 }
1250 return true;
1251 }
1252 // Disabled texture reads leave the rasterizer's block mask unchanged
1253 // (SLAU011A, sections 4.4.6 and 4.9.7). Direct-index LUT fills generate
1254 // block colors without memory reads and still require validation.
1255 if (!(r(TextureReadMode) & 1) && (r(TextureLUTMode) & 3) != 3)
1256 return true;
1257 if ((value & 1) && (r(AreaStippleMode) & 1))
1258 {
1259 report("TEXTURE_BLOCK_STIPPLE", AreaStippleMode, r(AreaStippleMode),
1260 "Area-stippled texture-memory block-mask streams are not implemented",
1261 true);
1262 return false;
1263 }
1264
1265 // Bound section 4.9.7's cached-font operation to forward rectangles and a
1266 // linear one-dimensional mask stream. FastFill bypasses the framebuffer
1267 // read unit, so retained Packed state does not change these native pixels.
1268 if ((value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveRectangle ||
1269 (value & (PositiveX | PositiveY)) != (PositiveX | PositiveY) ||
1270 (value & (SyncMask | SyncHost)))
1271 {
1272 report(
1273 "TEXTURE_BLOCK_GEOMETRY",
1274 Render,
1275 value,
1276 "Textured block fills require a forward native-pixel rectangle without "
1277 "host streams",
1278 true);
1279 return false;
1280 }
1281 const uint32_t read_mode = r(TextureReadMode);
1282 const unsigned bytes = texture_bytes();
1283 if (r(TextureAddressMode) != 1 || (read_mode & ~0x1fe1fu) ||
1284 (read_mode & 0x1f) != 0x0b || ((read_mode >> 9) & 15) > 11 ||
1285 ((read_mode >> 13) & 15) > 11 || (r(TextureLUTMode) & 3) ||
1286 (r(TextureMapFormat) & ~0x3901ffu) ||
1287 (r(TextureDataFormat) & ~0x200u) ||
1288 (r(TextureBaseAddress) & 0xff000000u) || bytes == 0)
1289 {
1290 report(
1291 "TEXTURE_BLOCK_MODE",
1292 TextureReadMode,
1293 read_mode,
1294 "Only local linear repeat-addressed block masks without LUT, "
1295 "filtering or color conversion are implemented",
1296 true);
1297 return false;
1298 }
1299 // S/T have 18 significant fractional bits aligned above two unused low
1300 // bits, so the register representation has its integer boundary at bit 20.
1301 if ((r(SStart) & 0xfffffu) ||
1302 (r(dSdx) != 0x100000u && r(dSdx) != 0xfff00000u) || r(dSdyDom) != 0 ||
1303 r(TStart) != 0 || r(dTdx) != 0 || r(dTdyDom) != 0)
1304 {
1305 report(
1306 "TEXTURE_BLOCK_DDA",
1307 SStart,
1308 r(SStart),
1309 "Block masks require integral S, a unit S step per block and zero "
1310 "T/Y derivatives",
1311 true);
1312 return false;
1313 }
1314 if ((r(RectangleSize) & 0xffff) > 32 && bytes != 4)
1315 {
1316 report(
1317 "TEXTURE_BLOCK_WIDTH",
1318 RectangleSize,
1319 r(RectangleSize),
1320 "Block masks wider than 32 pixels require 32-bit texels",
1321 true);
1322 return false;
1323 }
1324 return true;
1325}
1326
1327bool CPermedia2::validate_texture_copy(uint32_t value)
1328{
1329 // The initial indexed copy uses a linear CI8 map and one texel per native
1330 // framebuffer pixel (SLAU011A, sections 4.9.1/4.9.4/4.13.1).
1331 const uint32_t read_mode = r(TextureReadMode);
1332 const uint32_t format =
1333 ((r(DitherMode) >> 2) & 15) | ((r(DitherMode) >> 12) & 16);
1334 const uint32_t logical_mode = r(LogicalOpMode);
1335 const unsigned logical_op = (logical_mode >> 1) & 15;
1336 const bool destination_op = (logical_mode & 1) &&
1337 logical_op != 0 && logical_op != 3 && logical_op != 12 &&
1338 logical_op != 15;
1339 // Non-dithered CI8 formatting preserves the texture index in either color
1340 // order. The ordinary logical-op unit then combines it with the destination
1341 // (SLAU011A, sections 4.9.4/4.15.1 and the DitherMode format table).
1342 if ((value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveTrapezoid ||
1343 (value & (FastFill | SyncMask | SyncHost | 1u)) ||
1344 r(TextureAddressMode) != 1 || r(TextureColorMode) != 7 ||
1345 r(TextureLUTMode) != 0 ||
1346 (r(TextureDataFormat) & ~0x20u) != 14 ||
1347 (r(TextureMapFormat) & ~0x1ffu) ||
1348 pitch_from_products(r(TextureMapFormat)) == 0 ||
1349 (r(TextureBaseAddress) & 0xff000000u) ||
1350 (read_mode & ~0x1fe01u) || !(read_mode & 1) ||
1351 ((read_mode >> 9) & 15) > 11 || ((read_mode >> 13) & 15) > 11 ||
1352 render_bytes() != 1 || (r(ColorDDAMode) & 1) ||
1353 (r(DepthMode) & 1) || (r(LBWriteMode) & 1) ||
1354 ((r(DitherMode) & 1) && format != 14) || (logical_mode & 0x20) ||
1355 (r(FBReadMode) & (ReadSource | Packed | 0x48000u)) ||
1356 (r(FBWriteConfig) & 0x40000u) ||
1357 ((r(FBReadMode) & ReadDestination) &&
1358 ((r(FBReadMode) ^ r(FBWriteConfig)) & 0x101ffu)) ||
1359 ((destination_op || r(FBSoftwareWriteMask) != 0xffffffffu) &&
1360 !(r(FBReadMode) & ReadDestination)))
1361 {
1362 report("RENDER_MODE", Render, value,
1363 "Only linear nearest-clamped CI8 texture copies with native "
1364 "indexed framebuffer pixels are implemented", true);
1365 return false;
1366 }
1367 const int64_t left = int64_t(sx(r(StartXDom), 32)) / 65536;
1368 const int64_t right = int64_t(sx(r(StartXSub), 32)) / 65536;
1369 const int64_t top = int64_t(sx(r(StartY), 32)) / 65536;
1370 const uint32_t rows = r(RasterCount) & 0xffff;
1371 if (((r(StartXDom) | r(StartXSub) | r(StartY)) & 0xffff) ||
1372 r(dXDom) != 0 || r(dXSub) != 0 || r(dY) != 0x10000 ||
1373 right < left || right - left > 65535 || (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x30) ||
1374 ((r(SStart) | r(TStart)) & 0xfffff) || r(dSdx) != 0x100000 ||
1375 r(dSdyDom) != 0 || r(dTdx) != 0 || r(dTdyDom) != 0x100000)
1376 {
1377 report("TEXTURE_COPY_GEOMETRY", Render, value,
1378 "Indexed texture copies require an integral forward trapezoid "
1379 "and unit S/T steps", true);
1380 return false;
1381 }
1382 // Limit clipping can alter rasterizer interpolation. Admit only a complete
1383 // footprint inside the limits until that continuation behavior is modeled.
1384 if ((r(RasterizerMode) & 0x40000) && rows != 0 && right != left &&
1385 (left < sx(r(XLimits), 12) || right > sx(r(XLimits) >> 16, 12) ||
1386 top < sx(r(YLimits), 12) ||
1387 top + rows > sx(r(YLimits) >> 16, 12)))
1388 {
1389 report("TEXTURE_COPY_LIMITS", RasterizerMode, r(RasterizerMode),
1390 "Indexed texture-copy footprint must lie inside active X/Y limits",
1391 true);
1392 return false;
1393 }
1394 if ((r(ScissorMode) & 2) &&
1395 (sx(r(WindowOrigin), 12) || sx(r(WindowOrigin) >> 16, 12)))
1396 {
1397 report("TEXTURE_COPY_SCISSOR", WindowOrigin, r(WindowOrigin),
1398 "Translated screen scissoring is not implemented for texture copies",
1399 true);
1400 return false;
1401 }
1402 return true;
1403}
1404
1405bool CPermedia2::texture_copy_color(uint32_t& value)
1406{
1407 const unsigned width_bits = (r(TextureReadMode) >> 9) & 15;
1408 const unsigned height_bits = (r(TextureReadMode) >> 13) & 15;
1409 const unsigned pitch = pitch_from_products(r(TextureMapFormat));
1410 if (width_bits > 11 || height_bits > 11 || pitch == 0)
1411 {
1412 report("TEXTURE_COPY_LAYOUT", TextureMapFormat, r(TextureMapFormat),
1413 "Invalid active indexed texture layout", true);
1414 return false;
1415 }
1416 // Integral unit gradients let row/col preserve the complete texture DDA
1417 // position, including across snapshots, without additional hidden state.
1418 const int64_t s = int64_t(sx(r(SStart), 32)) / 0x100000 + m_job.col;
1419 const int64_t t = int64_t(sx(r(TStart), 32)) / 0x100000 + m_job.row;
1420 const int64_t sc = std::max<int64_t>(0,
1421 std::min<int64_t>((int64_t(1) << width_bits) - 1, s));
1422 const int64_t tc = std::max<int64_t>(0,
1423 std::min<int64_t>((int64_t(1) << height_bits) - 1, t));
1424 const int64_t address = int64_t(r(TextureBaseAddress)) + tc * pitch + sc;
1425 if (address < 0 || address >= int64_t(VramSize))
1426 {
1427 report("TEXTURE_COPY_RANGE", TextureBaseAddress, r(TextureBaseAddress),
1428 "Indexed texture source lies outside local VRAM", true);
1429 return false;
1430 }
1431 value = m_vram[static_cast<size_t>(address)];
1432 return true;
1433}
1434
1435bool CPermedia2::load_texture_mask()
1436{
1437 // Recheck the mask layout before deriving a source address.
1438 if (!validate_texture_block(m_job.command))
1439 return false;
1440 const unsigned bytes = texture_bytes();
1441 // Scissor rejection precedes texture addressing, including for block fills
1442 // (SLAU011A, sections 4.1/4.5). Only surviving 32-pixel blocks advance the
1443 // continuous mask stream of section 4.9.7. Keep a partially clipped block's
1444 // original bit phase; rejected pixels within it still consume their bits.
1445 const int64_t origin_x = m_job.origin_x, origin_y = m_job.origin_y;
1446 int64_t left = origin_x, right = origin_x + m_job.columns;
1447 int64_t top = origin_y, bottom = origin_y + m_job.rows;
1448 if (r(ScissorMode) & 1)
1449 {
1450 left = std::max<int64_t>(left, sx(r(ScissorMin), 16));
1451 right = std::min<int64_t>(right, sx(r(ScissorMax), 16));
1452 top = std::max<int64_t>(top, sx(r(ScissorMin) >> 16, 16));
1453 bottom = std::min<int64_t>(bottom, sx(r(ScissorMax) >> 16, 16));
1454 }
1455 if (r(ScissorMode) & 2)
1456 {
1457 left = std::max<int64_t>(left, 0);
1458 right = std::min<int64_t>(right, r(ScreenSize) & 0xffff);
1459 top = std::max<int64_t>(top, 0);
1460 bottom = std::min<int64_t>(bottom, r(ScreenSize) >> 16);
1461 }
1462 const int64_t first_block = (left - origin_x) / 32;
1463 const int64_t past_block = (right - origin_x + 31) / 32;
1464 const int64_t row = m_job.row, column_block = m_job.col / 32;
1465 if (left >= right || top >= bottom || row < top - origin_y ||
1466 row >= bottom - origin_y || column_block < first_block ||
1467 column_block >= past_block)
1468 {
1469 // Retain ordinary job progress without reading a rejected source block.
1470 m_job.payload = 0;
1471 m_job.payload_left = std::min(32u, m_job.columns - m_job.col);
1472 return true;
1473 }
1474 const int64_t block = (row - (top - origin_y)) *
1475 (past_block - first_block) + column_block - first_block;
1476 const int64_t s = int64_t(sx(r(SStart), 32)) / 0x100000 +
1477 block * (int64_t(sx(r(dSdx), 32)) / 0x100000);
1478 const int64_t width = int64_t(1) << ((r(TextureReadMode) >> 9) & 15);
1479 const int64_t texel = (s % width + width) % width;
1480 const int64_t address =
1481 (int64_t(r(TextureBaseAddress) & 0xffffffu) + texel) * bytes;
1482 if (address < 0 || address > int64_t(VramSize - bytes))
1483 {
1484 report(
1485 "TEXTURE_BLOCK_RANGE",
1486 TextureBaseAddress,
1487 r(TextureBaseAddress),
1488 "Block-mask source is outside local VRAM",
1489 true);
1490 return false;
1491 }
1492 uint32_t mask = pixel_read(address, bytes);
1493 if (r(TextureDataFormat) & 0x200)
1494 {
1495 // SpanFormat mirrors each byte; it does not reverse byte order or use
1496 // RasterizerMode's independent host BitMaskPattern controls.
1497 mask = ((mask & 0x55555555u) << 1) | ((mask >> 1) & 0x55555555u);
1498 mask = ((mask & 0x33333333u) << 2) | ((mask >> 2) & 0x33333333u);
1499 mask = ((mask & 0x0f0f0f0fu) << 4) | ((mask >> 4) & 0x0f0f0f0fu);
1500 }
1501 // Fetch once before writing any destination pixel. Source/destination
1502 // overlap and a snapshot within this block must retain the fetched mask.
1503 m_job.payload = mask;
1504 m_job.payload_left = std::min(32u, m_job.columns - m_job.col);
1505 return true;
1506}
1507
1508bool CPermedia2::vertex_write(uint32_t address, uint32_t value)
1509{
1510 const unsigned parameter = ((address - V0Fixed) / 8) & 15;
1511 if (parameter == 13 || parameter == 15)
1512 return false;
1513 const bool fixed = address < V0Float;
1514 const uint32_t canonical = fixed ? address + (V0Float - V0Fixed) : address;
1515 const uint32_t vertex = canonical - parameter * 8;
1516 if (parameter == 14)
1517 {
1518 // Both address aliases carry the same packed color layout. Individual
1519 // component reads return the shared floating-point vertex storage.
1520 r(canonical) = r(canonical - (V0Float - V0Fixed)) = value;
1521 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
1522 {
1523 const unsigned lane = (r(DeltaMode) & 0x40000) && i != 1 && i != 3
1524 ? 2 - i : i;
1525 const uint32_t component = vertex_bits(float((value >> (lane * 8)) & 255) / 255);
1526 r(vertex + (5 + i) * 8) = component;
1527 r(vertex - (V0Float - V0Fixed) + (5 + i) * 8) = component;
1528 }
1529 return true;
1530 }
1531 float converted = vertex_float(value);
1532 if (fixed)
1533 {
1534 if (parameter == 10 || parameter == 11)
1535 converted = float(sx(value, 32) / 65536.0);
1536 else if (parameter == 3 || parameter == 4)
1537 converted = float(double(value & 0xffffffu) / 4194304.0);
1538 else if (parameter == 9)
1539 converted = float(sx(value, 32) / 4194304.0);
1540 else if (parameter <= 2)
1541 converted = float(sx(value, 32) / 1073741824.0);
1542 else
1543 converted = float(double(value & 0x7fffffffu) / 1073741824.0);
1544 }
1545 if (std::isfinite(converted))
1546 {
1547 if (parameter <= 2)
1548 {
1549 if (((r(DeltaMode) >> 14) & 3) == 1)
1550 converted = std::max(-1.0f, std::min(1.0f, converted));
1551 }
1552 else if (r(DeltaMode) & 0x2000)
1553 {
1554 const float minimum = parameter == 9 ? -512.0f
1555 : parameter == 10 || parameter == 11 ? -32768.0f : 0.0f;
1556 const float maximum = parameter == 3 ? 2.0f : parameter == 9 ? 512.0f
1557 : parameter == 10 || parameter == 11 ? std::nextafter(32768.0f, 0.0f) : 1.0f;
1558 converted = std::max(minimum, std::min(maximum, converted));
1559 }
1560 }
1561 // Fixed and floating ports name one vertex component. Setup sorting must
1562 // never alter these values; software reuses them for strips and fans.
1563 r(canonical) = r(canonical - (V0Float - V0Fixed)) = vertex_bits(converted);
1564 return true;
1565}
1566
1567void CPermedia2::draw_triangle(uint32_t value)
1568{
1569 const uint32_t mode = r(DeltaMode);
1570 // Delta generates the ordinary rasterizer/color/depth register stream.
1571 // Texture, fog, setup-only and line setup require their own calculations.
1572 const uint32_t delta_controls = 3u | 0xcu | 0xc0u | 0x400u | 0x800u |
1573 0x2000u | 0xc000u | 0x20000u | 0x40000u | 0x80000u;
1574 if ((mode & ~delta_controls) || (mode & 3) == 1 || (mode & 3) == 3 ||
1575 (value & ~(0x40u | 1u | 0x10000u | 0x80000u | 0x100000u)) ||
1576 ((mode & 0x20000) && ((mode | value) & 0x80000)) ||
1577 (value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveTrapezoid ||
1578 !(value & 0x10000) || !(mode & 0x400) ||
1579 (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x30) || (r(FBReadMode) & Packed))
1580 {
1581 report("DELTA_MODE", DrawTriangle, value,
1582 "Only untextured subpixel-corrected color/depth triangle setup with zero "
1583 "coordinate bias is implemented", true);
1584 return;
1585 }
1586 const bool smooth = (mode & 0x40) != 0;
1587 const bool depth = (mode & 0x80) != 0;
1588 const unsigned depth_format = (mode >> 2) & 3;
1589 if (((r(ColorDDAMode) & 3) == 3 && !smooth) ||
1590 ((r(DepthMode) & 1) && ((r(DepthMode) >> 2) & 3) == 0 && !depth) ||
1591 (depth && (depth_format > 1 ||
1592 ((r(DepthMode) & 1) && r(LBReadFormat) != (depth_format ? 0u : 3u)))))
1593 {
1594 report("DELTA_INTERPOLATION", DeltaMode, mode,
1595 "Triangle setup must supply the enabled color/depth DDAs and "
1596 "match the local-buffer depth width", true);
1597 return;
1598 }
1599 // The common driver also emits the Gamma-only Delta coordinate-bias bit
1600 // and a legacy strip-orientation bit in Draw. Decode the PM2 fields here;
1601 // combinations with enabled face culling remain outside this setup path.
1602 const uint32_t command = value & ~(0x80000u | 0x100000u);
1603 if (!validate_render(command, true))
1604 return;
1605 struct Vertex
1606 {
1607 double x, y, z, color[3], alpha;
1608 };
1609 Vertex vertex[3]{};
1610 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
1611 {
1612 const uint32_t base = V0Float + i * 0x80;
1613 vertex[i].x = vertex_float(r(base + 10 * 8));
1614 vertex[i].y = vertex_float(r(base + 11 * 8));
1615 vertex[i].z = vertex_float(r(base + 12 * 8));
1616 vertex[i].alpha = vertex_float(r(base + 8 * 8));
1617 bool valid = std::isfinite(vertex[i].x) && std::isfinite(vertex[i].y) &&
1618 vertex[i].x >= -2048 && vertex[i].x < 2048 &&
1619 vertex[i].y >= -2048 && vertex[i].y < 2048;
1620 if (depth)
1621 valid = valid && std::isfinite(vertex[i].z) &&
1622 vertex[i].z >= 0 && vertex[i].z <= 1;
1623 if (smooth)
1624 {
1625 valid = valid && std::isfinite(vertex[i].alpha) &&
1626 vertex[i].alpha >= 0 && vertex[i].alpha <= 1;
1627 for (unsigned c = 0; c < 3; ++c)
1628 {
1629 vertex[i].color[c] = vertex_float(r(base + (5 + c) * 8));
1630 valid = valid && std::isfinite(vertex[i].color[c]) &&
1631 vertex[i].color[c] >= 0 && vertex[i].color[c] <= 1;
1632 }
1633 }
1634 if (!valid)
1635 {
1636 report("DELTA_VERTEX", base, r(base + 10 * 8),
1637 "Triangle vertex exceeds the modeled rasterizer/color/depth range",
1638 true);
1639 return;
1640 }
1641 }
1642 if (smooth && (vertex[0].alpha != vertex[1].alpha ||
1643 vertex[0].alpha != vertex[2].alpha))
1644 {
1645 report("DELTA_ALPHA", DrawTriangle, value,
1646 "Triangle setup with varying vertex alpha is not implemented", true);
1647 return;
1648 }
1649 const double area = (vertex[1].x - vertex[0].x) *
1650 (vertex[2].y - vertex[0].y) - (vertex[2].x - vertex[0].x) *
1651 (vertex[1].y - vertex[0].y);
1652 if (area == 0 || ((mode & 0x20000) &&
1653 ((value & 0x100000) ? area < 0 : area > 0)))
1654 {
1655 m_job = {};
1656 return;
1657 }
1658 std::stable_sort(std::begin(vertex), std::end(vertex),
1659 [](const Vertex& a, const Vertex& b) { return a.y < b.y; });
1660 const Vertex& a = vertex[0];
1661 const Vertex& b = vertex[1];
1662 const Vertex& c = vertex[2];
1663 const double long_slope = (c.x - a.x) / (c.y - a.y);
1664 const double first_slope = b.y == a.y ? 0 : (b.x - a.x) / (b.y - a.y);
1665 const double second_slope = c.y == b.y ? 0 : (c.x - b.x) / (c.y - b.y);
1666 const auto raster_y = [](double y) {
1667 return fixed_integer(int64_t(std::trunc(y * 65536)) + 0x7fff);
1668 };
1669 const int64_t first_y = raster_y(a.y), middle_y = raster_y(b.y);
1670 const int64_t last_y = raster_y(c.y);
1671 const uint32_t first_rows = uint32_t(middle_y - first_y);
1672 const uint32_t second_rows = uint32_t(last_y - middle_y);
1673 if (first_rows == 0 && second_rows == 0)
1674 {
1675 m_job = {};
1676 return;
1677 }
1678 const bool correction = (value & 0x10000) && (mode & 0x400);
1679 const int64_t start_y = first_rows ? first_y : middle_y;
1680 const double sample_y = double(start_y) + 0.5;
1681 const double error_y = correction ? sample_y - a.y : 0;
1682 const double xdom = a.x + error_y * long_slope;
1683 const double xsub = first_rows ? a.x + error_y * first_slope
1684 : b.x + (correction ? sample_y - b.y : 0) * second_slope;
1685 const bool split = first_rows && second_rows;
1686 const double knee_x = split ? b.x +
1687 (correction ? double(middle_y) + 0.5 - b.y : 0) * second_slope : 0;
1688 // Pixel-center coverage uses the nearly-half bias before integer DDA
1689 // extraction. Sorting is private; the reusable vertex registers are intact.
1690 const auto coordinate = [](double x, int64_t& result) {
1691 // PM2's signed 12.15 DDAs are aligned to 16.16; bit zero is unused.
1692 const double fixed = std::trunc(x * 32768) * 2;
1693 if (!std::isfinite(fixed) || fixed < -134217728 || fixed > 134217726)
1694 return false;
1695 result = int64_t(fixed);
1696 return true;
1697 };
1698 int64_t start_dom, start_sub, delta_dom, delta_sub;
1699 int64_t next_sub = 0, next_delta = 0;
1700 // A half with no scanlines generates no continuation. Its unused edge
1701 // slope can exceed the DDA range even when the rendered half fits.
1702 if (!coordinate(xdom, start_dom) ||
1703 !coordinate(xsub, start_sub) ||
1704 !coordinate(long_slope, delta_dom) ||
1705 !coordinate(first_rows ? first_slope : second_slope, delta_sub) ||
1706 (split && (!coordinate(knee_x, next_sub) ||
1707 !coordinate(second_slope, next_delta))) ||
1708 start_y < -2048 || last_y > 2048 ||
1709 first_rows > 65535 || second_rows > 65535)
1710 {
1711 report("DELTA_RANGE", DrawTriangle, value,
1712 "Triangle setup exceeds the modeled fixed-point DDA range", true);
1713 return;
1714 }
1715 const auto edge_range = [](int64_t start, int64_t delta, uint32_t rows) {
1716 if (rows == 0)
1717 return true;
1718 const int64_t end = start + delta * (rows - 1);
1719 return start + 0x7fff >= -134217728 && start + 0x7fff < 134217728 &&
1720 end + 0x7fff >= -134217728 && end + 0x7fff < 134217728;
1721 };
1722 if (!edge_range(start_dom, delta_dom, first_rows + second_rows) ||
1723 !edge_range(start_sub, delta_sub, first_rows ? first_rows : second_rows) ||
1724 (split && !edge_range(next_sub, next_delta, second_rows)))
1725 {
1726 report("DELTA_RANGE", DrawTriangle, value,
1727 "Triangle edge exceeds the modeled rasterizer range", true);
1728 return;
1729 }
1730 // X limits accelerate rasterization but are not a true scissor (SLAU011A,
1731 // section 4.4.13). When the user scissor is enclosed by the limits, retain
1732 // the complete edge walk and interpolants; the scissor rejects fragments
1733 // before local-buffer or framebuffer writes. Other limit-crossing cases
1734 // still require the rasterizer's X termination behavior.
1735 if (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x40000)
1736 {
1737 const double left = std::min(a.x, std::min(b.x, c.x));
1738 const double right = std::max(a.x, std::max(b.x, c.x));
1739 const int32_t minimum = sx(r(XLimits), 12);
1740 const int32_t maximum = sx(r(XLimits) >> 16, 12);
1741 const bool scissored = (r(ScissorMode) & 1) &&
1742 sx(r(ScissorMin), 16) >= minimum &&
1743 sx(r(ScissorMax), 16) <= maximum;
1744 if (!scissored && (raster_y(left) < minimum || raster_y(right) > maximum))
1745 {
1746 report("DELTA_LIMITS", XLimits, r(XLimits),
1747 "Limit-crossing triangle setup requires a user scissor inside "
1748 "the active rasterizer X limits",
1749 true);
1750 return;
1751 }
1752 }
1753 const double determinant = (b.x - a.x) * (c.y - a.y) -
1754 (c.x - a.x) * (b.y - a.y);
1755 const double direction = determinant > 0 ? 1 : -1;
1756 int64_t colors[3]{}, dx[3]{}, dy[3]{}, z = 0, zdx = 0, zdy = 0;
1757 const auto interpolate = [&](double av, double bv, double cv, double scale,
1758 int64_t minimum, int64_t maximum, int64_t& start, int64_t& xstep,
1759 int64_t& ystep) {
1760 const double gradient_x = ((bv - av) * (c.y - a.y) -
1761 (cv - av) * (b.y - a.y)) / determinant;
1762 const double gradient_y = ((b.x - a.x) * (cv - av) -
1763 (c.x - a.x) * (bv - av)) / determinant;
1764 const double dominant = gradient_y + long_slope * gradient_x;
1765 const double values[3] = { (av + error_y * dominant) * scale,
1766 gradient_x * direction * scale, dominant * scale };
1767 int64_t fixed[3]{};
1768 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
1769 {
1770 const double v = std::trunc(values[i] * 2048);
1771 if (!std::isfinite(v))
1772 return false;
1773 // Delta clamps its float-to-fixed conversions (3Dlabs, Hot Chips
1774 // 1996, page 23). Generated color/depth fields are signed 9.11 /
1775 // 17.11; this saturation is separate from vertex input clamping
1776 // and from the rasterizer's subsequent fixed-point arithmetic.
1777 fixed[i] = int64_t(std::max(double(minimum), std::min(double(maximum), v)));
1778 }
1779 start = fixed[0]; xstep = fixed[1]; ystep = fixed[2];
1780 return true;
1781 };
1782 bool valid = true;
1783 if (smooth)
1784 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
1785 valid = valid && interpolate(a.color[i], b.color[i], c.color[i],
1786 255, -524288, 524287, colors[i], dx[i], dy[i]);
1787 if (depth)
1788 valid = valid && interpolate(a.z, b.z, c.z,
1789 depth_format ? 65535 : 32767, -134217728, 134217727, z, zdx, zdy);
1790 if (!valid)
1791 {
1792 report("DELTA_INTERPOLANT_RANGE", DrawTriangle, value,
1793 "Triangle interpolation produced a non-finite value",
1794 true);
1795 return;
1796 }
1797 // Delta supplies the edge bias in its generated coordinates. The
1798 // rasterizer's separate BiasCoordinates field therefore stays zero.
1799 r(StartXDom) = uint32_t(start_dom + 0x7fff);
1800 r(StartXSub) = uint32_t(start_sub + 0x7fff);
1801 r(StartY) = uint32_t(start_y * 65536);
1802 r(dXDom) = uint32_t(delta_dom);
1803 r(dXSub) = uint32_t(delta_sub);
1804 r(dY) = 65536;
1805 r(RasterCount) = first_rows ? first_rows : second_rows;
1806 if (smooth)
1807 {
1808 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
1809 {
1810 r(RStart + i * 24) = uint32_t(colors[i]) << 4;
1811 r(dRdx + i * 24) = uint32_t(dx[i]) << 4;
1812 r(dRdyDom + i * 24) = uint32_t(dy[i]) << 4;
1813 }
1814 r(AStart) = uint32_t(std::trunc(a.alpha * 255 * 2048)) << 4;
1815 }
1816 if (depth)
1817 {
1818 r(ZStartU) = uint32_t(z >> 11) & 0x1ffff;
1819 r(ZStartL) = uint32_t(z) << 21;
1820 r(dZdxU) = uint32_t(zdx >> 11) & 0x1ffff;
1821 r(dZdxL) = uint32_t(zdx) << 21;
1822 r(dZdyDomU) = uint32_t(zdy >> 11) & 0x1ffff;
1823 r(dZdyDomL) = uint32_t(zdy) << 21;
1824 }
1825 r(Render) = command;
1826 start_render(command, true);
1827 if (m_job.active && split)
1828 {
1829 m_job.knee_rows = second_rows;
1830 m_job.knee_xsub = next_sub + 0x7fff;
1831 m_job.knee_dxsub = next_delta;
1832 }
1833}
1834
1835bool CPermedia2::local_buffer_copy() const
1836{
1837 // ForceLBUpdate can copy LBSourceData with both tests disabled (SLAU011A,
1838 // sections 4.6/4.7 and Window). The write gates are applied separately.
1839 return !(r(DepthMode) & 1) && !(r(StencilMode) & 1) &&
1840 (r(Window) & 0x18) == 8 && (r(LBReadMode) & 0x200);
1841}
1842
1843bool CPermedia2::validate_interpolants(uint32_t value, bool setup)
1844{
1845 // Block-write fragments do not visit the color or local-buffer units.
1846 if (value & FastFill)
1847 return true;
1848 const bool gouraud = (r(ColorDDAMode) & 3) == 3;
1849 const bool depth = (r(DepthMode) & 1) != 0;
1850 const bool copy = local_buffer_copy();
1851 const bool local = depth || copy || (r(LBWriteMode) & 1);
1852 if (!setup && (gouraud || local) &&
1853 ((r(RasterizerMode) & 0x40000) ||
1854 ((r(ScissorMode) & 2) &&
1855 (sx(r(WindowOrigin), 12) || sx(r(WindowOrigin) >> 16, 12)))))
1856 {
1857 report("INTERPOLATION_CLIP", Render, value,
1858 "Rasterizer limits and translated screen scissoring are not "
1859 "implemented for color/depth interpolation", true);
1860 return false;
1861 }
1862 if ((r(ColorDDAMode) & 1) && (r(ColorDDAMode) & ~3u))
1863 {
1864 report("COLOR_DDA_MODE", ColorDDAMode, r(ColorDDAMode),
1865 "Unknown enabled color DDA control", true);
1866 return false;
1867 }
1868 if ((gouraud || local) &&
1869 ((value & (SyncHost | SyncMask)) || (r(FBReadMode) & Packed) ||
1870 (r(FBReadMode) & ReadSource) || framebuffer_upload(value)))
1871 {
1872 report("INTERPOLATION_MODE", Render, value,
1873 "Host streams, packed pixels and framebuffer copies/uploads are "
1874 "not implemented with interpolated color or depth", true);
1875 return false;
1876 }
1877 if (gouraud && (value & 0xc0) == PrimitiveRectangle)
1878 {
1879 report("COLOR_DDA_PRIMITIVE", Render, value,
1880 "Gouraud rectangle interpolation is not implemented", true);
1881 return false;
1882 }
1883 if (!local)
1884 return true;
1885 const uint32_t mode = r(LBReadMode);
1886 const uint32_t read_format = r(LBReadFormat);
1887 const uint32_t write_format = r(LBWriteFormat);
1888 if (copy)
1889 {
1890 // LBDefault format 0 assigns all sixteen storage bits to depth. Other
1891 // field layouts and combined framebuffer operations remain unmodeled.
1892 if ((mode & ~(0x1ffu | 0x200u | 0x40000u)) ||
1893 pitch_from_products(mode) == 0 || read_format != 0 || write_format != 0 ||
1894 (r(LBWriteMode) & ~1u) || (r(LBWindowBase) & 0xff000000u) ||
1895 (r(Window) & ~(0x18u | 0x40000u)) || (r(ColorDDAMode) & 1) ||
1896 (value & Texture) || (r(FBWriteMode) & 1) ||
1897 (r(FBReadMode) & (ReadSource | ReadDestination | Packed)))
1898 {
1899 report("LB_COPY_MODE", LBReadMode, mode,
1900 "Forced local-buffer copies require linear 16-bit LBDefault "
1901 "source data with framebuffer reads and writes disabled", true);
1902 return false;
1903 }
1904 return true;
1905 }
1906 const unsigned function = (r(DepthMode) >> 4) & 7;
1907 const unsigned source = (r(DepthMode) >> 2) & 3;
1908 const bool write = (r(LBWriteMode) & 1) && !(r(Window) & 0x40000);
1909 if ((mode & ~(0x1ffu | 0x400u | 0x40000u)) ||
1910 pitch_from_products(mode) == 0 ||
1911 (read_format != 0 && read_format != 3) ||
1912 (write_format != 0 && write_format != 3) ||
1913 (write && read_format != write_format) ||
1914 (r(LBWriteMode) & ~1u) || (r(LBWindowBase) & 0xff000000u) ||
1915 (r(Window) & ~(0x18u | 0x40000u)) ||
1916 (depth && ((r(DepthMode) & ~0x7fu) || (source != 0 && source != 2))) ||
1917 (depth && function != 0 && function != 7 && !(mode & 0x400)))
1918 {
1919 report("DEPTH_MODE", DepthMode, r(DepthMode),
1920 "Only linear 15/16-bit local-buffer depth tests with fragment or "
1921 "constant-register depth are implemented", true);
1922 return false;
1923 }
1924 if (depth && source == 0 && (value & 0xc0) == PrimitiveRectangle)
1925 {
1926 report("DEPTH_PRIMITIVE", Render, value,
1927 "Depth DDA rectangle interpolation is not implemented", true);
1928 return false;
1929 }
1930 // Force-update interactions with a failed test or masked depth are outside
1931 // this first slice. The ordinary constant-depth clear is unambiguous.
1932 if (write && (r(Window) & 8) &&
1933 (!(r(Window) & 16) || !depth || source != 2 || function != 7 ||
1934 !(r(DepthMode) & 2)))
1935 {
1936 report("DEPTH_FORCE_MODE", Window, r(Window),
1937 "Forced local-buffer updates require a writable constant-depth "
1938 "clear with an Always comparison", true);
1939 return false;
1940 }
1941 return true;
1942}
1943
1944uint32_t CPermedia2::interpolation_kind(uint32_t value) const
1945{
1946 if (value & FastFill)
1947 return 0;
1948 return ((r(ColorDDAMode) & 3) == 3 ? 1u : 0u) |
1949 ((r(DepthMode) & 1) ? (((r(DepthMode) >> 2) & 3) == 0 ? 2u : 4u) : 0u);
1950}
1951
1952void CPermedia2::load_interpolants(bool starts)
1953{
1954 if (starts)
1955 m_job.interpolation = interpolation_kind(m_job.command);
1956 // Color registers carry signed 9.11 in bits 23..4. Alpha uses the same
1957 // start format but is not interpolated (SLAU011A, sections 4.12/7.11).
1958 if (m_job.interpolation & 1)
1959 {
1960 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
1961 {
1962 if (starts)
1963 m_job.color[i] = sx(r(RStart + i * 24) >> 4, 20);
1964 m_job.dcolor_dx[i] = sx(r(dRdx + i * 24) >> 4, 20);
1965 m_job.dcolor_dy[i] = sx(r(dRdyDom + i * 24) >> 4, 20);
1966 }
1967 if (starts)
1968 {
1969 const int32_t alpha = sx(r(AStart) >> 4, 20);
1970 m_job.alpha = static_cast<uint32_t>(
1971 std::max(0, std::min(255, alpha / 2048)));
1972 }
1973 }
1974 if (m_job.interpolation & 2)
1975 {
1976 // Upper words carry signed 17-bit integers; lower words carry eleven
1977 // left-justified fractional bits (SLAU011A, pp. 7-59..7-62).
1978 if (starts)
1979 m_job.z = int64_t(sx(r(ZStartU), 17)) * 2048 + (r(ZStartL) >> 21);
1980 m_job.dzdx = int64_t(sx(r(dZdxU), 17)) * 2048 + (r(dZdxL) >> 21);
1981 m_job.dzdy = int64_t(sx(r(dZdyDomU), 17)) * 2048 + (r(dZdyDomL) >> 21);
1982 }
1983}
1984
1985void CPermedia2::step_interpolants()
1986{
1987 if (m_job.interpolation & 1)
1988 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
1989 m_job.color[i] += m_job.dcolor_dy[i];
1990 if (m_job.interpolation & 2)
1991 m_job.z += m_job.dzdy;
1992}
1993
1994uint32_t CPermedia2::fragment_color() const
1995{
1996 if (!(r(ColorDDAMode) & 2))
1997 return r(ConstantColor);
1998 uint32_t color = m_job.alpha << 24;
1999 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
2000 {
2001 // X derivatives are increments along the span, from dominant toward
2002 // subordinate. Lines use only the dominant-edge derivative.
2003 int64_t component = m_job.color[i] +
2004 (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid
2005 ? int64_t(m_job.col) * m_job.dcolor_dx[i]
2006 : 0);
2007 if (m_job.setup && (m_job.command & 0x10000))
2008 {
2009 const bool forward = m_job.xdom <= m_job.xsub;
2010 const int64_t first = fixed_integer(m_job.xdom) - (forward ? 0 : 1);
2011 const int64_t error = first * 65536 + 65535 - m_job.xdom;
2012 component += fixed_integer(error * m_job.dcolor_dx[i] *
2013 (forward ? 1 : -1));
2014 }
2015 const uint32_t byte = static_cast<uint32_t>(
2016 std::max<int64_t>(0, std::min<int64_t>(255, component / 2048)));
2017 color |= byte << (8 * i);
2018 }
2019 return color;
2020}
2021
2022bool CPermedia2::depth_test(int32_t x, int32_t y)
2023{
2024 if (local_buffer_copy())
2025 {
2026 if (!(r(LBWriteMode) & 1) || (r(Window) & 0x40000))
2027 return true;
2028 const int64_t sign = (r(LBReadMode) & 0x40000) ? -1 : 1;
2029 const int64_t destination = int64_t(r(LBWindowBase)) +
2030 int64_t(y) * pitch_from_products(r(LBReadMode)) * sign + x;
2031 const int64_t source = destination + sx(r(LBSourceOffset), 24);
2032 // Both addresses are in native local-buffer pixels, independently of
2033 // framebuffer size, pitch and masks (SLAU011A, section 4.6.1).
2034 if (destination < 0 || destination >= int64_t(VramSize / 2) ||
2035 source < 0 || source >= int64_t(VramSize / 2))
2036 {
2037 report("LB_COPY_RANGE", LBSourceOffset, r(LBSourceOffset),
2038 "Local-buffer copy source or destination lies outside VRAM", true);
2039 return false;
2040 }
2041 const uint32_t data = pixel_read(source * 2, 2);
2042 m_vram[static_cast<size_t>(destination * 2)] = uint8_t(data);
2043 m_vram[static_cast<size_t>(destination * 2 + 1)] = uint8_t(data >> 8);
2044 return true;
2045 }
2046 if (!(r(DepthMode) & 1))
2047 return true;
2048 // Keep malformed restored states bounded as well as newly issued draws.
2049 const uint32_t format = r(LBReadFormat);
2050 const unsigned pitch = pitch_from_products(r(LBReadMode));
2051 if ((format != 0 && format != 3) || pitch == 0)
2052 {
2053 report("DEPTH_LAYOUT", LBReadMode, r(LBReadMode),
2054 "Invalid active local-buffer depth layout", true);
2055 return false;
2056 }
2057 const uint32_t mask = format == 3 ? 0x7fff : 0xffff;
2058 int64_t z = 0;
2059 if (((r(DepthMode) >> 2) & 3) == 2)
2060 z = int64_t(r(Depth)) * 2048;
2061 else
2062 z = m_job.z + (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid
2063 ? int64_t(m_job.col) * m_job.dzdx
2064 : 0);
2065 if (m_job.setup && (m_job.command & 0x10000) &&
2066 ((r(DepthMode) >> 2) & 3) == 0)
2067 {
2068 const bool forward = m_job.xdom <= m_job.xsub;
2069 const int64_t first = fixed_integer(m_job.xdom) - (forward ? 0 : 1);
2070 const int64_t error = first * 65536 + 65535 - m_job.xdom;
2071 z += fixed_integer(error * m_job.dzdx * (forward ? 1 : -1));
2072 }
2073 // Color saturation is specified; depth overflow is not. Reject values
2074 // outside the modeled depth range instead of inventing wrap or clamp rules.
2075 if (z < 0 || z > int64_t(mask) * 2048 + 2047)
2076 {
2077 report("DEPTH_RANGE", DepthMode, r(DepthMode),
2078 "Interpolated depth exceeds the local-buffer depth width", true);
2079 return false;
2080 }
2081 const int64_t sign = (r(LBReadMode) & 0x40000) ? -1 : 1;
2082 const int64_t pixel = int64_t(r(LBWindowBase)) +
2083 int64_t(y) * pitch * sign + x;
2084 const int64_t address = pixel * 2;
2085 if (address < 0 || address > int64_t(VramSize - 2))
2086 {
2087 report("DEPTH_ADDRESS", LBWindowBase, r(LBWindowBase),
2088 "Local-buffer fragment lies outside VRAM", true);
2089 return false;
2090 }
2091 const uint32_t old = pixel_read(address, 2);
2092 const uint32_t source = old & mask;
2093 const uint32_t fragment = static_cast<uint32_t>(z / 2048);
2094 bool pass = false;
2095 switch ((r(DepthMode) >> 4) & 7)
2096 {
2097 case 0:
2098 pass = false;
2099 break;
2100 case 1:
2101 pass = fragment < source;
2102 break;
2103 case 2:
2104 pass = fragment == source;
2105 break;
2106 case 3:
2107 pass = fragment <= source;
2108 break;
2109 case 4:
2110 pass = fragment > source;
2111 break;
2112 case 5:
2113 pass = fragment != source;
2114 break;
2115 case 6:
2116 pass = fragment >= source;
2117 break;
2118 case 7:
2119 pass = true;
2120 break;
2121 }
2122 if (pass && (r(DepthMode) & 2) && (r(LBWriteMode) & 1) &&
2123 !(r(Window) & 0x40000))
2124 {
2125 // Depth writes have their own controls; framebuffer software/hardware
2126 // masks do not replace DepthMode.WriteMask. Preserve non-depth planes.
2127 const uint32_t value = (old & ~mask) | fragment;
2128 m_vram[static_cast<size_t>(address)] = uint8_t(value);
2129 m_vram[static_cast<size_t>(address) + 1] = uint8_t(value >> 8);
2130 }
2131 return pass;
2132}
2133
2134bool CPermedia2::packed_trapezoid(uint32_t command) const
2135{
2136 return (command & 0xc0) == PrimitiveTrapezoid && !(command & FastFill) &&
2137 (r(FBReadMode) & Packed);
2138}
2139
2140bool CPermedia2::validate_packed_trapezoid(
2141 const Job& job, uint32_t address, uint32_t value)
2142{
2143 if (job.row >= job.rows)
2144 return true;
2145 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
2146 if (bytes != 1 && bytes != 2 && bytes != 4)
2147 return false;
2148 const int64_t scale = 4 / bytes;
2149 const bool host = (job.command & SyncHost) != 0;
2150 const int64_t alignment = host ? m_relative_offset : 0;
2151 const int64_t steps = job.rows - job.row - 1;
2152 const int64_t a = fixed_integer(job.xdom);
2153 const int64_t b = fixed_integer(job.xsub);
2154 const int64_t ae = fixed_integer(job.xdom + job.dxdom * steps);
2155 const int64_t be = fixed_integer(job.xsub + job.dxsub * steps);
2156 const int64_t y = fixed_integer(job.y);
2157 const int64_t ye = fixed_integer(job.y + job.dy * steps);
2158 const int64_t left = std::min(std::min(a, b), std::min(ae, be));
2159 const int64_t right = std::max(std::max(a, b), std::max(ae, be));
2160 const int64_t width = std::max(std::abs(job.xdom - job.xsub),
2161 std::abs(job.xdom + job.dxdom * steps -
2162 job.xsub - job.dxsub * steps));
2163 if (left * scale < INT32_MIN || right * scale > INT32_MAX ||
2164 left * scale + alignment < INT32_MIN ||
2165 right * scale + alignment > INT32_MAX ||
2166 std::min(y, ye) < INT32_MIN || std::max(y, ye) > INT32_MAX ||
2167 (width + 65535) / 65536 > 65535 ||
2168 (steps != 0 && job.dy != 65536 && job.dy != -65536))
2169 {
2170 report("PACKED_GEOMETRY", address, value,
2171 "Packed trapezoids require bounded coordinates and unit scanline steps",
2172 true);
2173 return false;
2174 }
2175 if (host && (job.xdom > job.xsub ||
2176 job.xdom + job.dxdom * steps > job.xsub + job.dxsub * steps))
2177 {
2178 report("PACKED_HOST_DIRECTION", address, value,
2179 "Reverse-X packed trapezoid host downloads are not implemented", true);
2180 return false;
2181 }
2182 // Limits belong to the rasterizer, before the framebuffer read unit
2183 // converts DWORD-group X coordinates into native pixels (PRM 4.4.13/6.4.1).
2184 // Host synchronization automatically disables these limits (PRM 4.4.13).
2185 if (!host && (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x40000) &&
2186 (left < sx(r(XLimits), 12) || right > sx(r(XLimits) >> 16, 12) ||
2187 std::min(y, ye) < sx(r(YLimits), 12) ||
2188 std::max(y, ye) >= sx(r(YLimits) >> 16, 12)))
2189 {
2190 report("PACKED_LIMITS", address, value,
2191 "Packed trapezoid footprint must lie inside active X/Y limits",
2192 true);
2193 return false;
2194 }
2195 return true;
2196}
2197
2198bool CPermedia2::validate_render(uint32_t value, bool setup)
2199{
2200 // Render.Texture qualifies the texture units (SLAU011A, p. 4-79). Their
2201 // retained mode registers have no effect when this command leaves it clear.
2202 // Section 4.9.7 defines a separate block-fill mask path. Ordinary texture
2203 // reads are bounded to the linear indexed copy path validated below.
2204 const bool texture_block =
2205 (value & (FastFill | Texture)) == (FastFill | Texture);
2206 const bool texture_copy = (value & Texture) && !(value & FastFill);
2207 const uint32_t unsupported = r(AlphaBlendMode) | r(AlphaTestMode) |
2208 r(StencilMode) | r(FogMode) | r(AntialiasMode) |
2209 r(YUVMode);
2210 // Block-write fragments bypass these units and use raw FBBlockColor
2211 // (SLAU011A, sections 4.4.6 and 4.11.2). Their retained state is inactive.
2212 if (!(value & FastFill) && ((unsupported & 1) ||
2213 (r(LogicalOpMode) & ~63u)))
2214 {
2215 report(
2216 "RENDER_MODE",
2217 Render,
2218 value,
2219 "Unsupported blending, alpha/stencil test, fog, antialias, YUV, "
2220 "texture, dither or logical-operation mode",
2221 true);
2222 return false;
2223 }
2224 if (!(value & FastFill) && (r(DitherMode) & 3) == 3)
2225 {
2226 const uint32_t format =
2227 ((r(DitherMode) >> 2) & 15) | ((r(DitherMode) >> 12) & 16);
2228 if (format != 16 || (r(DitherMode) & 0x800) || render_bytes() != 2)
2229 {
2230 report("DITHER_MODE", DitherMode, r(DitherMode),
2231 "Only ordered RGB565 dithering with native 16-bit pixels "
2232 "is implemented", true);
2233 return false;
2234 }
2235 }
2236 if (!validate_interpolants(value, setup))
2237 return false;
2238 if ((r(FBReadMode) | r(FBWriteConfig)) & 0x40000)
2239 {
2240 // Subpatch host downloads use native 16/32-bit pixels and a top-left
2241 // origin. Other patched reads, copies and render operations still need
2242 // their own addressing and pipeline rules.
2243 const uint32_t layout = 0x6000000u | 0x40000u | 0x10000u | 0x1ffu;
2244 if ((r(FBReadMode) & layout) != (r(FBWriteConfig) & layout) ||
2245 (r(FBWriteConfig) & (0x6000000u | 0x10000u)) != 0x2000000u ||
2246 !(value & SyncHost) || (value & (FastFill | Texture | SyncMask)) ||
2247 (r(FBReadMode) & (ReadSource | ReadDestination | Packed)) ||
2248 (r(ColorDDAMode) & 1) || !(r(FBWriteMode) & 1) ||
2249 (render_bytes() != 2 && render_bytes() != 4) ||
2250 pitch_from_products(r(FBWriteConfig)) == 0)
2251 {
2252 report("FB_PATCH_MODE", FBWriteConfig, r(FBWriteConfig),
2253 "Only top-left 16/32-bit Subpatch host downloads are implemented",
2254 true);
2255 return false;
2256 }
2257 }
2258 if (texture_block && !validate_texture_block(value))
2259 return false;
2260 if (texture_copy && !validate_texture_copy(value))
2261 return false;
2262 if ((value & SyncMask) && (value & SyncHost))
2263 {
2264 report(
2265 "DUAL_HOST_STREAM",
2266 Render,
2267 value,
2268 "Combined bitmask and host-color streams not implemented",
2269 true);
2270 return false;
2271 }
2272 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
2273 const bool local_only = !(value & FastFill) &&
2274 ((r(DepthMode) & 1) || local_buffer_copy()) &&
2275 !(r(FBWriteMode) & 1) &&
2276 !(r(FBReadMode) & (ReadSource | ReadDestination | Packed));
2277 if (!local_only && (bytes == 0 ||
2278 pitch_from_products(r(FBWriteConfig)) == 0 ||
2279 ((r(FBReadMode) & Packed) && (bytes == 3))))
2280 {
2281 report(
2282 "PIXEL_LAYOUT",
2283 Render,
2284 value,
2285 "Invalid pitch/pixel size or packed 24-bit mode",
2286 true);
2287 return false;
2288 }
2289 if ((r(FBReadMode) & Packed) && !(value & FastFill) &&
2290 (value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveRectangle)
2291 {
2292 const bool host = (value & SyncHost) != 0;
2293 if ((value & 0xc0) != PrimitiveTrapezoid ||
2294 (value & (SyncMask | Texture)) ||
2295 (host ? (r(FBReadMode) & ReadSource) != 0
2296 : !(r(FBReadMode) & ReadSource)) ||
2297 (r(FBReadMode) & 0x8000) ||
2298 pitch_from_products(r(FBReadMode)) == 0 ||
2299 ((value & 1) && (r(AreaStippleMode) & 1)) ||
2300 (r(ColorDDAMode) & 1) || (r(DitherMode) & 1) ||
2301 (r(LogicalOpMode) & 0x20) || (r(ScissorMode) & 3))
2302 {
2303 report("PACKED_PRIMITIVE", Render, value,
2304 "Only linear raw framebuffer-source copies and host downloads "
2305 "are implemented for packed trapezoids", true);
2306 return false;
2307 }
2308 const uint32_t mask = r(FBSoftwareWriteMask);
2309 const bool repeated = bytes == 4 ||
2310 (bytes == 2 && (mask & 0xffff) * 0x10001u == mask) ||
2311 (bytes == 1 && (mask & 0xff) * 0x1010101u == mask);
2312 if (!repeated || (mask != 0xffffffffu &&
2313 !(r(FBReadMode) & ReadDestination)))
2314 {
2315 report("PACKED_MASK", FBSoftwareWriteMask, mask,
2316 !repeated
2317 ? "Nonreplicated packed trapezoid software masks are not implemented"
2318 : "Software writemasking requires framebuffer destination reads",
2319 true);
2320 return false;
2321 }
2322 if (host)
2323 {
2324 const uint32_t logical_mode = r(LogicalOpMode);
2325 const unsigned op = (logical_mode >> 1) & 15;
2326 const bool destination_op = (logical_mode & 1) &&
2327 op != 0 && op != 3 && op != 12 && op != 15;
2328 if ((destination_op && !(r(FBReadMode) & ReadDestination)) ||
2329 ((r(FBReadMode) & ReadDestination) &&
2330 ((r(FBReadMode) ^ r(FBWriteConfig)) & 0x101ffu)))
2331 {
2332 report("PACKED_HOST_READ", FBReadMode, r(FBReadMode),
2333 "Packed host logical operations require matching destination reads",
2334 true);
2335 return false;
2336 }
2337 if (std::abs(m_relative_offset) >= int(4 / bytes))
2338 {
2339 report("HOST_ALIGNMENT", FBReadMode, r(FBReadMode),
2340 "Whole-word packed trapezoid host alignment is not implemented",
2341 true);
2342 return false;
2343 }
2344 }
2345 }
2346 // FBColor destination reads go directly to Host Out, independently of
2347 // FBWriteMode.WriteEnable (SLAU011A, Table 4-18). Formatted uploads and
2348 // combined read/write pipelines require additional ordering/format rules.
2349 if (!(value & FastFill) && (r(FBReadMode) & 0x8000) &&
2350 (r(FBReadMode) & (ReadSource | ReadDestination)))
2351 {
2352 if (!framebuffer_upload(value) || (r(FBReadMode) & ReadSource) ||
2353 (r(DitherMode) & 1) || (r(FBWriteMode) & 1) ||
2354 (value & (FastFill | Texture | SyncMask | SyncHost)) ||
2355 ((value & 1) && (r(AreaStippleMode) & 1)) ||
2356 ((r(FBReadMode) & Packed) && (r(ScissorMode) & 3)) ||
2357 (!(r(FBReadMode) & Packed) && bytes != 4))
2358 {
2359 report(
2360 "FB_UPLOAD_MODE",
2361 FBReadMode,
2362 r(FBReadMode),
2363 "Only raw destination uploads with disabled framebuffer writes "
2364 "are implemented; "
2365 "formatting, packed scissoring, stippled and unpacked "
2366 "narrow-pixel uploads "
2367 "are unsupported",
2368 true);
2369 return false;
2370 }
2371 }
2372 const bool constant_fb_data = !framebuffer_upload(value) &&
2373 !(value & FastFill) && (r(LogicalOpMode) & 0x20);
2374 if (constant_fb_data)
2375 {
2376 // FBWriteData replaces the fragment color in the Logic Op unit. It cannot
2377 // be combined with logical operations or software writemasking
2378 // (SLAU011A, pp. 7-81/7-102); hardware writemasks still apply.
2379 if ((r(LogicalOpMode) & 1) || r(FBSoftwareWriteMask) != 0xffffffffu ||
2380 (r(DepthMode) & 1) || (r(ColorDDAMode) & 3) == 3)
2381 {
2382 report(
2383 "FB_CONSTANT_MODE",
2384 LogicalOpMode,
2385 r(LogicalOpMode),
2386 "Constant framebuffer data requires disabled logical "
2387 "operations "
2388 "and software writemasking, flat color and no depth test",
2389 true);
2390 return false;
2391 }
2392 if (bytes == 3)
2393 {
2394 report(
2395 "FB_CONSTANT_LAYOUT",
2396 FBReadPixel,
2397 r(FBReadPixel),
2398 "Constant framebuffer data in 24-bit pixel mode is not "
2399 "implemented",
2400 true);
2401 return false;
2402 }
2403 }
2404 // Restrict primitive-control flags to the subset modeled here. Do not
2405 // acknowledge unknown render features as if a primitive completed.
2406 // NT4 sets reserved bit 5 (SLAU011A, Table 4-6); retain it without effect.
2407 const uint32_t reserved_bit_5 = 0x20u;
2408 const uint32_t supported = 0xc0u | 1u | reserved_bit_5 | FastFill |
2409 SyncMask | SyncHost | PositiveX | PositiveY |
2410 ((texture_block || texture_copy) ? Texture : 0) |
2411 (setup ? 0x10000u : 0);
2412 if (value & ~supported)
2413 {
2414 report(
2415 "RENDER_FLAGS", Render, value, "Unimplemented Render flag", true);
2416 return false;
2417 }
2418 // NT4 sets reserved bits 1 and 2 (SLAU011A, p. 7-82). Retain them
2419 // without effect; the actual host-upload control is bit 3.
2420 if (r(FBWriteMode) & ~7u)
2421 {
2422 report(
2423 "FB_WRITE_MODE",
2424 FBWriteMode,
2425 r(FBWriteMode),
2426 "Host readback or non-normal framebuffer write mode not "
2427 "implemented",
2428 true);
2429 return false;
2430 }
2431 if ((value & SyncHost) && (r(FBReadMode) & Packed) &&
2432 m_relative_offset != 0 &&
2433 ((!packed_trapezoid(value) && !(value & PositiveX)) ||
2434 (r(DitherMode) & 1)))
2435 {
2436 report(
2437 "HOST_ALIGNMENT",
2438 FBReadMode,
2439 r(FBReadMode),
2440 "Nonzero packed host alignment requires forward X and raw "
2441 "color mode",
2442 true);
2443 return false;
2444 }
2445 if (!(value & FastFill) && (r(DitherMode) & 1))
2446 {
2447 const uint32_t fmt =
2448 ((r(DitherMode) >> 2) & 15) | ((r(DitherMode) >> 12) & 16);
2449 if (fmt != 0 && fmt != 1 && fmt != 2 && fmt != 14 && fmt != 16)
2450 {
2451 report(
2452 "COLOR_FORMAT",
2453 DitherMode,
2454 r(DitherMode),
2455 "Formatted color mode not implemented",
2456 true);
2457 return false;
2458 }
2459 }
2460 const unsigned coordinate_bias = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 4) & 3;
2461 if (coordinate_bias == 3)
2462 {
2463 report(
2464 "RASTERIZER_BIAS",
2465 RasterizerMode,
2466 r(RasterizerMode),
2467 "Undefined coordinate bias encoding",
2468 true);
2469 return false;
2470 }
2471 if (value & (SyncMask | SyncHost))
2472 {
2473 // RasterizerMode retains independent bitmask and host-color controls
2474 // (SLAU011A, pp. 7-111/7-112). Drivers need not clear the inactive fields
2475 // when switching streams: draw_step applies only the selected controls.
2476 // FractionAdjust is retained here and acts only on ContinueNewLine.
2477 const uint32_t bitmask_controls =
2478 1u | 2u | 0x40u | 0x180u | 0x200u | 0x7c00u;
2479 const uint32_t host_controls = 0x18000u;
2480 // SyncOnHostData and SyncOnBitMask automatically disable X/Y limits,
2481 // regardless of the retained LimitsEnable bit (SLAU011A, sec. 4.4.13).
2482 const uint32_t limits_enable = 1u << 18;
2483 if (r(RasterizerMode) &
2484 ~(bitmask_controls | host_controls | limits_enable | 0x3cu))
2485 {
2486 report(
2487 "RASTERIZER_MODE",
2488 RasterizerMode,
2489 r(RasterizerMode),
2490 "Host rasterizer option not implemented",
2491 true);
2492 return false;
2493 }
2494 }
2495 if ((value & FastFill) && (value & SyncMask) &&
2496 (r(RasterizerMode) & (0x40u | 0x200u | 0x7c00u)))
2497 {
2498 report(
2499 "BLOCK_MASK_MODE",
2500 RasterizerMode,
2501 r(RasterizerMode),
2502 "Block mask background/packing/offset combinations not implemented",
2503 true);
2504 return false;
2505 }
2506 return true;
2507}
2508
2509void CPermedia2::start_render(uint32_t value, bool setup)
2510{
2511 m_job = {};
2512 if (!validate_render(value, setup))
2513 return;
2514 m_job.setup = setup;
2515 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
2516 const unsigned coordinate_bias = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 4) & 3;
2517 m_job.command = value;
2518 m_job.primitive = value & 0xc0;
2519 m_job.origin_x = sx(r(RectangleOrigin), 16);
2520 m_job.origin_y = sx(r(RectangleOrigin) >> 16, 16);
2521 m_job.xdom = sx(r(StartXDom), 32);
2522 m_job.xsub = sx(r(StartXSub), 32);
2523 m_job.y = sx(r(StartY), 32);
2524 m_job.dxdom = sx(r(dXDom), 32);
2525 m_job.dxsub = sx(r(dXSub), 32);
2526 m_job.dy = sx(r(dY), 32);
2527 load_interpolants(true);
2528 if (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle)
2529 {
2530 m_job.columns = r(RectangleSize) & 0xffff;
2531 m_job.rows = (r(RectangleSize) >> 16) & 0xffff;
