2532 // Packed-copy coordinates are converted by the framebuffer read unit.
2533 // Block fills bypass that unit and keep the rasterizer's native pixels.
2534 if ((r(FBReadMode) & Packed) && !(value & FastFill) &&
2535 !framebuffer_upload(value))
2536 {
2537 m_job.origin_x *= static_cast<int32_t>(4 / bytes);
2538 m_job.columns *= 4 / bytes;
2539 }
2540 }
2541 else
2542 {
2543 m_job.rows =
2544 m_job.primitive == PrimitivePoint ? 1 : (r(RasterCount) & 0xffff);
2545 // Bias is added on DDA load, not on register writes or subsequent steps
2546 // (SLAU011A, p. 7-112). RectangleOrigin uses a separate integer path.
2547 const int64_t bias = coordinate_bias == 1 ? 0x8000
2548 : coordinate_bias == 2 ? 0x7fff
2549 : 0;
2550 m_job.xdom += bias;
2551 m_job.xsub += bias;
2552 m_job.y += bias;
2553 // Keep fractional X edges and line Y increments in the signed 16.16 DDAs.
2554 // Only address generation extracts their integer portions (SLAU011A,
2555 // pp. 4-27/4-31). Trapezoids advance whole scanlines; fractional dY is for
2556 // X-major lines (p. 7-58), and a single-row primitive never consumes it.
2557 if (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid && m_job.rows > 1 &&
2558 (m_job.dy % 65536))
2559 {
2560 report(
2561 "FRACTIONAL_DDA",
2562 Render,
2563 value,
2564 "Fractional trapezoid vertical increments are not implemented",
2565 true);
2566 return;
2567 }
2568 set_span();
2569 if (packed_trapezoid(value) &&
2570 !validate_packed_trapezoid(m_job, Render, value))
2571 return;
2572 }
2573 if (m_job.columns > 262140 || m_job.rows > 65535)
2574 {
2575 report("GEOMETRY", Render, value, "Invalid geometry", true);
2576 return;
2577 }
2578 // A trapezoid's first span can round to zero width while later spans widen.
2579 m_job.active = m_job.rows != 0 &&
2580 (m_job.columns != 0 || m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid);
2581}
2582
2583void CPermedia2::continue_render(uint32_t address, uint32_t value)
2584{
2585 if (m_job.setup)
2586 {
2587 report("SETUP_CONTINUATION", address, value,
2588 "Host continuations after setup-unit triangles are not implemented",
2589 true);
2590 return;
2591 }
2592 if ((m_job.command & Texture) && !(m_job.command & FastFill))
2593 {
2594 report("TEXTURE_COPY_CONTINUATION", address, value,
2595 "Texture-copy continuation requires retained S/T accumulators "
2596 "that are not implemented", true);
2597 return;
2598 }
2599 const bool line = address == ContinueNewLine;
2600 if (!line && (value & 0xfff) == 0 && !m_job.active &&
2601 m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle && m_job.col == 0 &&
2602 m_job.row == m_job.rows)
2603 {
2604 // A zero scanline count emits no fragments; NewDom/NewSub still load
2605 // their selected edge (SLAU011A, pp. 7-19/7-20/7-22). Rectangle rendering
2606 // did not traverse the Start* DDAs, so there is no deferred edge step.
2607 if (address == ContinueNewDom || address == ContinueNewSub)
2608 {
2609 const unsigned coordinate_bias = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 4) & 3;
2610 if (coordinate_bias == 3)
2611 {
2612 report("RASTERIZER_BIAS", RasterizerMode, r(RasterizerMode),
2613 "Undefined coordinate bias encoding", true);
2614 return;
2615 }
2616 const int64_t bias = coordinate_bias == 1 ? 0x8000
2617 : coordinate_bias == 2 ? 0x7fff : 0;
2618 if (address == ContinueNewDom)
2619 m_job.xdom = int64_t(sx(r(StartXDom), 32)) + bias;
2620 else
2621 m_job.xsub = int64_t(sx(r(StartXSub), 32)) + bias;
2622 }
2623 m_job.dxdom = sx(r(dXDom), 32);
2624 m_job.dxsub = sx(r(dXSub), 32);
2625 m_job.dy = sx(r(dY), 32);
2626 m_job.row = m_job.col = m_job.rows = 0;
2627 // Keep the rectangle identity: this does not establish a nonzero
2628 // line/trapezoid continuation history.
2629 return;
2630 }
2631 if (m_job.active || m_job.col != 0 || m_job.row != m_job.rows ||
2632 (line ? m_job.primitive != PrimitiveLine || m_job.columns != 1
2633 : m_job.primitive != PrimitiveTrapezoid))
2634 {
2635 report(
2636 "CONTINUATION_STATE",
2637 address,
2638 value,
2639 "Continuation requires a matching completed line or trapezoid",
2640 true);
2641 return;
2642 }
2643 if (m_job.command & (SyncHost | SyncMask))
2644 {
2645 report(
2646 "CONTINUATION_STREAM",
2647 address,
2648 value,
2649 "Synchronized continuation payload rules are not implemented",
2650 true);
2651 return;
2652 }
2653 if (!validate_render(m_job.command))
2654 return;
2655 if (m_job.interpolation != interpolation_kind(m_job.command))
2656 {
2657 report("CONTINUATION_INTERPOLATION", address, value,
2658 "Changing color/depth interpolation sources during a continuation "
2659 "chain is not implemented", true);
2660 return;
2661 }
2662 Job next = m_job;
2663 // Completed jobs retain the last rendered DDA position. Recover the
2664 // hardware's next endpoint using the OLD slopes, before loading new ones
2665 // (SLAU011A, pp. 2-4/7-19..7-22). A zero-count command has no deferred step.
2666 if (next.rows != 0)
2667 {
2668 next.xdom += next.dxdom;
2669 next.xsub += next.dxsub;
2670 next.y += next.dy;
2671 if (next.interpolation & 1)
2672 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
2673 next.color[i] += next.dcolor_dy[i];
2674 if (next.interpolation & 2)
2675 next.z += next.dzdy;
2676 }
2677 if (line)
2678 {
2679 const unsigned adjustment = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 2) & 3;
2680 if (adjustment)
2681 {
2682 const int64_t fraction = adjustment == 1 ? 0
2683 : adjustment == 2 ? 0x8000
2684 : 0x7fff;
2685 // Replace only the fraction. In particular, negative values retain their
2686 // signed integer portion, and coordinate bias is not added a second time.
2687 next.xdom = fixed_integer(next.xdom) * 65536 + fraction;
2688 next.y = fixed_integer(next.y) * 65536 + fraction;
2689 }
2690 }
2691 else
2692 {
2693 const unsigned coordinate_bias = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 4) & 3;
2694 const int64_t bias = coordinate_bias == 1 ? 0x8000
2695 : coordinate_bias == 2 ? 0x7fff
2696 : 0;
2697 if (address == ContinueNewDom)
2698 next.xdom = int64_t(sx(r(StartXDom), 32)) + bias;
2699 else if (address == ContinueNewSub)
2700 next.xsub = int64_t(sx(r(StartXSub), 32)) + bias;
2701 // Continue retains both edges; every trapezoid continuation retains Y.
2702 }
2703 next.dxdom = sx(r(dXDom), 32);
2704 next.dxsub = sx(r(dXSub), 32);
2705 next.dy = sx(r(dY), 32);
2706 next.row = next.col = 0;
2707 next.rows =
2708 value & 0xfff; // The command count does not overwrite RasterCount.
2709 if (!line && next.rows > 1 && (next.dy % 65536))
2710 {
2711 report(
2712 "FRACTIONAL_DDA",
2713 address,
2714 value,
2715 "Fractional trapezoid vertical increments are not implemented",
2716 true);
2717 return;
2718 }
2719
2720 // Chained continuations must remain representable by fragment coordinates
2721 // and the existing snapshot bounds. A 12-bit count times a signed 32-bit
2722 // increment is safe in int64; check both ends of each linear DDA interval.
2723 const auto valid_dda = [&next](int64_t position, int64_t delta) {
2724 const int64_t limit = int64_t(1) << 47;
2725 const int64_t endpoint = position + delta * int64_t(next.rows);
2726 return position >= -limit && position < limit && endpoint >= -limit &&
2727 endpoint < limit;
2728 };
2729 if (!valid_dda(next.xdom, next.dxdom) ||
2730 !valid_dda(next.xsub, next.dxsub) || !valid_dda(next.y, next.dy))
2731 {
2732 report(
2733 "CONTINUATION_RANGE",
2734 address,
2735 value,
2736 "Continuation coordinates exceed the modeled DDA range",
2737 true);
2738 return;
2739 }
2740 if (next.interpolation & 1)
2741 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
2742 if (!valid_dda(next.color[i], sx(r(dRdyDom + i * 24) >> 4, 20)))
2743 {
2744 report("COLOR_RANGE", address, value,
2745 "Continued color DDA exceeds the modeled range", true);
2746 return;
2747 }
2748 const int64_t dzdy = int64_t(sx(r(dZdyDomU), 17)) * 2048 +
2749 (r(dZdyDomL) >> 21);
2750 if ((next.interpolation & 2) && !valid_dda(next.z, dzdy))
2751 {
2752 report("DEPTH_RANGE", address, value,
2753 "Continued depth DDA exceeds the modeled range", true);
2754 return;
2755 }
2756 if (packed_trapezoid(next.command) &&
2757 !validate_packed_trapezoid(next, address, value))
2758 return;
2759 m_job = next;
2760 load_interpolants(false);
2761 set_span();
2762 // Empty trapezoid spans still advance the DDAs and consume a scanline.
2763 m_job.active = m_job.rows != 0;
2764}
2765
2766void CPermedia2::set_span()
2767{
2768 if (m_job.primitive != PrimitiveTrapezoid)
2769 {
2770 m_job.columns = 1;
2771 return;
2772 }
2773 const int64_t a = fixed_integer(m_job.xdom), b = fixed_integer(m_job.xsub);
2774 const int64_t width = a > b ? a - b : b - a;
2775 m_job.columns = static_cast<uint32_t>(std::min<int64_t>(width, 65535));
2776 // The rasterizer retains group coordinates. Expand only the emitted span;
2777 // multiplying a fractional DDA before taking its integer part changes edges.
2778 if (packed_trapezoid(m_job.command))
2779 m_job.columns *= 4 / render_bytes();
2780}
2781
2782void CPermedia2::next_fragment()
2783{
2784 if (++m_job.col < m_job.columns)
2785 return;
2786 m_job.col = 0;
2787 if ((m_job.command & (FastFill | Texture)) == (FastFill | Texture) &&
2788 (r(TextureReadMode) & 1))
2789 m_job.payload_left = 0;
2790 if (++m_job.row >= m_job.rows)
2791 {
2792 if (m_job.setup && m_job.knee_rows)
2793 {
2794 // Delta's second trapezoid keeps the dominant-edge interpolants
2795 // and replaces only the subordinate edge (PRM 4.2.1/4.3.10).
2796 step_interpolants();
2797 m_job.xdom += m_job.dxdom;
2798 m_job.y += m_job.dy;
2799 m_job.xsub = m_job.knee_xsub;
2800 m_job.dxsub = m_job.knee_dxsub;
2801 m_job.rows = m_job.knee_rows;
2802 m_job.row = m_job.knee_rows = 0;
2803 r(StartXSub) = uint32_t(m_job.xsub);
2804 r(dXSub) = uint32_t(m_job.dxsub);
2805 r(ContinueNewSub) = m_job.rows;
2806 set_span();
2807 return;
2808 }
2809 // Leave completed jobs at the last rendered DDA position.
2810 // A continuation applies this final DDA step before reloading slopes.
2811 m_job.active = false;
2812 return;
2813 }
2814 step_interpolants();
2815 if (m_job.primitive != PrimitiveRectangle)
2816 {
2817 // Accumulate before extracting coordinates, retaining subpixel carry.
2818 // Signed 32-bit inputs over the modeled 16-bit Count fit these int64 DDAs.
2819 m_job.xdom += m_job.dxdom;
2820 m_job.xsub += m_job.dxsub;
2821 m_job.y += m_job.dy;
2822 set_span();
2823 // Empty spans consume work but must not produce a fragment.
2824 }
2825 if ((m_job.command & SyncHost) ||
2826 ((m_job.command & SyncMask) && (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x200)))
2827 m_job.payload_left = 0;
2828}
2829
2830uint32_t CPermedia2::block_color(int32_t x, int32_t y) const
2831{
2832 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
2833 if (bytes == 3)
2834 return r(FBBlockColor); // Preserve the existing 24-bit scalar path.
2835 const int64_t sign = (r(FBWriteConfig) & 0x10000) ? -1 : 1;
2836 const int64_t pixel = int64_t(r(FBWindowBase)) + r(FBPixelOffset) + x +
2837 int64_t(y) * pitch_from_products(r(FBWriteConfig)) * sign;
2838 const unsigned shift = (uint32_t(pixel * bytes) & 7) * 8;
2839 const uint64_t pattern = uint64_t(r(FBBlockColorL)) |
2840 (uint64_t(r(FBBlockColorU)) << 32);
2841 return uint32_t(pattern >> shift);
2842}
2843
2844bool CPermedia2::draw_block()
2845{
2846 const bool rectangle = m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle;
2847 const bool forward = rectangle ? (m_job.command & PositiveX) != 0
2848 : m_job.xsub >= m_job.xdom;
2849 const int64_t first = rectangle
2850 ? int64_t(m_job.origin_x) + (forward ? 0 : m_job.columns - 1)
2851 : fixed_integer(m_job.xdom) - (forward ? 0 : 1);
2852 const int64_t last = first + (forward ? int64_t(m_job.columns - 1)
2853 : -int64_t(m_job.columns - 1));
2854 const int64_t y = rectangle
2855 ? int64_t(m_job.origin_y) + ((m_job.command & PositiveY)
2856 ? m_job.row : m_job.rows - 1 - m_job.row)
2857 : fixed_integer(m_job.y);
2858 // Leave exceptional coordinates to the ordinary fragment path. The block
2859 // calculation must not introduce a different narrowing or address wrap.
2860 if (first < INT32_MIN || first > INT32_MAX ||
2861 last < INT32_MIN || last > INT32_MAX || y < INT32_MIN || y > INT32_MAX)
2862 return false;
2863 int64_t left = INT32_MIN, right = int64_t(INT32_MAX) + 1;
2864 int64_t top = INT32_MIN, bottom = int64_t(INT32_MAX) + 1;
2865 if (r(ScissorMode) & 1)
2866 {
2867 left = sx(r(ScissorMin), 16);
2868 right = sx(r(ScissorMax), 16);
2869 top = sx(r(ScissorMin) >> 16, 16);
2870 bottom = sx(r(ScissorMax) >> 16, 16);
2871 }
2872 if (r(ScissorMode) & 2)
2873 {
2874 left = std::max<int64_t>(left, 0);
2875 right = std::min<int64_t>(right, r(ScreenSize) & 0xffff);
2876 top = std::max<int64_t>(top, 0);
2877 bottom = std::min<int64_t>(bottom, r(ScreenSize) >> 16);
2878 }
2879 const auto finish_span = [this]() {
2880 m_job.col = m_job.columns - 1;
2881 next_fragment();
2882 };
2883 if (y < top || y >= bottom || left >= right)
2884 {
2885 finish_span();
2886 return true;
2887 }
2888 int64_t x = first + (forward ? int64_t(m_job.col) : -int64_t(m_job.col));
2889 const int64_t begin = forward ? std::max(x, left) : std::min(x, right - 1);
2890 const int64_t end = forward ? std::min(last + 1, right) : std::max(last, left);
2891 if (forward ? begin >= end : begin < end)
2892 {
2893 finish_span();
2894 return true;
2895 }
2896 // Solid block writes have no color/depth interpolants or host payload.
2897 // True scissoring can therefore discard a prefix without stepping pixels.
2898 // Keep the original column index and span width for continuation/snapshots.
2899 m_job.col += uint32_t(forward ? begin - x : x - begin);
2900 x = begin;
2901 // SGRAM fills use 32 native pixels, with partial blocks at span edges
2902 // (SLAU011A, sections 3.3.3.2/4.4.6). Scissor and hardware masks still apply.
2903 const uint32_t lane = uint32_t(x) & 31;
2904 const uint32_t block = forward ? 32 - lane : lane + 1;
2905 const uint32_t count = uint32_t(std::min<int64_t>(block,
2906 forward ? end - x : x - end + 1));
2907 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
2908 {
2909 emit_pixel(int32_t(x), int32_t(y), block_color(int32_t(x), int32_t(y)), true);
2910 if (m_halted)
2911 return true;
2912 ++m_job.col;
2913 x += forward ? 1 : -1;
2914 }
2915 // Scissor-rejected suffixes cannot affect another unit in this solid path.
2916 if (m_job.col == m_job.columns || (forward ? x >= end : x < end))
2917 finish_span();
2918 return true;
2919}
2920
2921bool CPermedia2::draw_step()
2922{
2923 if (m_job.columns == 0)
2924 {
2925 next_fragment();
2926 return true;
2927 }
2928 const bool mask_stream = (m_job.command & SyncMask) != 0,
2929 host_stream = (m_job.command & SyncHost) != 0;
2930 const bool texture_lut =
2931 (m_job.command & (FastFill | Texture)) == (FastFill | Texture) &&
2932 (r(TextureLUTMode) & 3) == 3;
2933 const bool texture_block =
2934 (m_job.command & (FastFill | Texture)) == (FastFill | Texture) &&
2935 !texture_lut && (r(TextureReadMode) & 1);
2936 if (texture_lut && m_job.col == 0)
2937 {
2938 const int64_t y = m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle
2939 ? int64_t(m_job.origin_y) + ((m_job.command & PositiveY)
2940 ? m_job.row : m_job.rows - 1 - m_job.row)
2941 : fixed_integer(m_job.y);
2942 const uint32_t mode = r(TextureLUTMode);
2943 const unsigned index = (((uint32_t(y) & 7) * (8u >> ((mode >> 10) & 3))) +
2944 ((mode >> 2) & 255)) & 255;
2945 // Two raw LUT words replace the retained 64-bit block color (PRM4.9.6).
2946 r(FBBlockColorL) = m_texel_lut[index];
2947 r(FBBlockColorU) = m_texel_lut[(index + 1) & 255];
2948 }
2949 if ((m_job.command & FastFill) && !mask_stream && !host_stream &&
2950 !texture_block &&
2951 !((m_job.command & 1) && (r(AreaStippleMode) & 1)) &&
2952 (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid ||
2953 m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle) && draw_block())
2954 return true;
2955 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
2956 if (texture_block && m_job.payload_left == 0 && !load_texture_mask())
2957 return false;
2958 if ((mask_stream || host_stream) && m_job.payload_left == 0)
2959 {
2960 if (m_input.empty())
2961 return false;
2962 const Command c = m_input.front();
2963 if (mask_stream ? c.address != BitMaskPattern : !host_tag(c.address))
2964 {
2965 // A non-data write aborts a rasterizer waiting for host input.
2966 // Keep the command queued for normal execution; pixels already
2967 // supplied by the host remain drawn.
2968 m_job.active = false;
2969 return true;
2970 }
2971 if (host_stream &&
2972 (c.address == Depth || c.address == Stencil || c.address == Texel0 ||
2973 (packed_trapezoid(m_job.command) && c.address == FBSourceData)))
2974 {
2975 report(
2976 "HOST_DATA",
2977 c.address,
2978 c.value,
2979 "This host-data source is not implemented for the active primitive",
2980 true);
2981 return false;
2982 }
2983 m_input.pop_front();
2984 m_job.payload = c.value;
2985 m_job.payload_tag = c.address;
2986 if (mask_stream)
2987 {
2988 const unsigned swap = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 7) & 3;
2989 if (swap & 1)
2990 m_job.payload = ((m_job.payload & 0xff00ff) << 8) |
2991 ((m_job.payload >> 8) & 0xff00ff);
2992 if (swap & 2)
2993 m_job.payload = (m_job.payload << 16) | (m_job.payload >> 16);
2994 const unsigned skip = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 10) & 31;
2995 m_job.payload_left = 32;
2996 // BitMaskOffset selects the first position in a cyclic 32-bit word.
2997 // MirrorBitMask=0 consumes LSB first; =1 consumes MSB first.
2998 if (skip)
2999 {
3000 if (r(RasterizerMode) & 1)
3001 m_job.payload = (m_job.payload << skip) |
3002 (m_job.payload >> (32 - skip));
3003 else
3004 m_job.payload = (m_job.payload >> skip) |
3005 (m_job.payload << (32 - skip));
3006 }
3007 }
3008 else
3009 {
3010 const unsigned swap = (r(RasterizerMode) >> 15) & 3;
3011 if (swap & 1)
3012 m_job.payload = ((m_job.payload & 0xff00ff) << 8) |
3013 ((m_job.payload >> 8) & 0xff00ff);
3014 if (swap & 2)
3015 m_job.payload = (m_job.payload << 16) | (m_job.payload >> 16);
3016 m_job.payload_left = (r(FBReadMode) & Packed) ? 4 / bytes : 1;
3017 }
3018 return true;
3019 }
3020 int32_t x = 0, y = 0;
3021 if (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle)
3022 {
3023 x = m_job.origin_x +
3024 static_cast<int32_t>(
3025 (m_job.command & PositiveX) ? m_job.col
3026 : m_job.columns - 1 - m_job.col);
3027 y = m_job.origin_y +
3028 static_cast<int32_t>(
3029 (m_job.command & PositiveY) ? m_job.row
3030 : m_job.rows - 1 - m_job.row);
3031 }
3032 else
3033 {
3034 y = static_cast<int32_t>(fixed_integer(m_job.y));
3035 x = static_cast<int32_t>(fixed_integer(m_job.xdom));
3036 if (packed_trapezoid(m_job.command))
3037 x *= static_cast<int32_t>(4 / bytes);
3038 if (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid)
3039 x += (m_job.xsub >= m_job.xdom)
3040 ? static_cast<int32_t>(m_job.col)
3041 : -static_cast<int32_t>(m_job.col) - 1;
3042 }
3043 if (framebuffer_upload(m_job.command))
3044 {
3045 if (!upload_pixel(x, y))
3046 return false;
3047 next_fragment();
3048 return true;
3049 }
3050 const bool texture_copy =
3051 (m_job.command & Texture) && !(m_job.command & FastFill);
3052 // User/screen scissoring discards fragments before texture memory reads.
3053 if (texture_copy && clipped(x, y, false))
3054 {
3055 next_fragment();
3056 return true;
3057 }
3058 const bool dda = (r(ColorDDAMode) & 1) != 0;
3059 uint32_t color = dda ? fragment_color() : r(Color);
3060 bool raw = !dda, draw = true;
3061 if (m_job.command & FastFill)
3062 {
3063 color = block_color(x, y);
3064 raw = true;
3065 }
3066 if (texture_block)
3067 {
3068 draw = (m_job.payload & 1) != 0;
3069 m_job.payload >>= 1;
3070 --m_job.payload_left;
3071 }
3072 else if (texture_copy)
3073 {
3074 if (!texture_copy_color(color))
3075 return false;
3076 raw = true; // A CI8 texture in a CI8 framebuffer preserves its index.
3077 }
3078 else if (mask_stream)
3079 {
3080 const bool mirror = (r(RasterizerMode) & 1) != 0;
3081 bool bit = mirror ? (m_job.payload & 0x80000000u) != 0
3082 : (m_job.payload & 1) != 0;
3083 if (r(RasterizerMode) & 2)
3084 bit = !bit;
3085 if (mirror)
3086 m_job.payload <<= 1;
3087 else
3088 m_job.payload >>= 1;
3089 --m_job.payload_left;
3090 if (!bit)
3091 {
3092 if (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x40)
3093 {
3094 color = r(Texel0);
3095 raw = true;
3096 }
3097 else
3098 draw = false;
3099 }
3100 }
3101 else if (host_stream)
3102 {
3103 color = m_job.payload;
3104 raw = m_job.payload_tag != Color;
3105 if (bytes < 4)
3106 {
3107 // Standard Color keeps all four components until formatting. Native
3108 // downloads consume one such word per fragment (PRM 4.11.5).
3109 if (raw || !(r(DitherMode) & 1) || (r(FBReadMode) & Packed))
3110 color &= (1u << (bytes * 8)) - 1;
3111 m_job.payload >>= bytes * 8;
3112 }
3113 --m_job.payload_left;
3114 // Packed downloads shift the destination stream in native pixels
3115 // (SLAU011A, section 6.4.2), including across DWORD boundaries.
3116 if ((r(FBReadMode) & Packed) &&
3117 (m_job.primitive == PrimitiveRectangle ||
3118 packed_trapezoid(m_job.command)))
3119 x += m_relative_offset;
3120 }
3121 else if (!(m_job.command & FastFill) && (r(FBReadMode) & ReadSource))
3122 {
3123 const int64_t sign = (r(FBReadMode) & 0x10000) ? -1 : 1;
3124 const int64_t src = int64_t(r(FBSourceBase)) +
3125 int64_t(y) * pitch_from_products(r(FBReadMode)) * sign + x +
3126 r(FBPixelOffset) + sx(r(FBSourceOffset), 24) -
3127 ((r(FBReadMode) & Packed) ? m_relative_offset : 0);
3128 color = pixel_read(src * bytes, bytes);
3129 raw = true;
3130 }
3131 if (draw)
3132 emit_pixel(x, y, color, raw);
3133 if (m_halted)
3134 return false;
3135 next_fragment();
3136 return true;
3137}
3138
3139bool CPermedia2::framebuffer_upload(uint32_t command) const
3140{
3141 // Block-write fragments bypass the framebuffer read unit, regardless of its
3142 // retained read enables and datatype (SLAU011A, section 4.4.6).
3143 return !(command & FastFill) &&
3144 (r(FBReadMode) & (0x8000u | ReadDestination)) ==
3145 (0x8000u | ReadDestination);
3146}
3147
3148bool CPermedia2::upload_pixel(int32_t x, int32_t y)
3149{
3150 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
3151 const bool packed = (r(FBReadMode) & Packed) != 0;
3152 // Packed X addresses groups of a DWORD; pitch, base and pixel offset
3153 // remain in native-pixel units (SLAU011A, section 6.4.1). The packed
3154 // write limits and relative source alignment do not affect these reads.
3155 if (bytes == 0 || (packed && bytes == 3) || (!packed && bytes != 4))
3156 {
3157 report(
3158 "FB_UPLOAD_LAYOUT",
3159 FBReadPixel,
3160 r(FBReadPixel),
3161 "Unsupported restored framebuffer upload layout",
3162 true);
3163 return false;
3164 }
3165 const int64_t pixel_x = int64_t(x) * (packed ? 4 / bytes : 1);
3166 if (clipped(pixel_x, y, false))
3167 return true;
3168 const unsigned filter = (r(FilterMode) >> 8) & 3;
3169 const size_t words = (filter & 1) + ((filter >> 1) & 1);
3170 if (m_output.size() + words > 8)
3171 return false;
3172 const int64_t sign = (r(FBReadMode) & 0x10000) ? -1 : 1;
3173 const int64_t pixel = int64_t(r(FBWindowBase)) +
3174 int64_t(y) * pitch_from_products(r(FBReadMode)) * sign + pixel_x +
3175 r(FBPixelOffset);
3176 const uint32_t color = pixel_read(pixel * bytes, packed ? 4 : bytes);
3177 if (filter & 1)
3178 output_push(tag(FBColor));
3179 if (filter & 2)
3180 output_push(color);
3181 return true;
3182}
3183
3184bool CPermedia2::clipped(int64_t x, int64_t y, bool packed_limits) const
3185{
3186 if (m_job.setup && (r(RasterizerMode) & 0x40000))
3187 {
3188 if (y < sx(r(YLimits), 12) || y >= sx(r(YLimits) >> 16, 12))
3189 return true;
3190 }
3191 if (r(ScissorMode) & 1)
3192 {
3193 if (x < sx(r(ScissorMin), 16) || y < sx(r(ScissorMin) >> 16, 16) ||
3194 x >= sx(r(ScissorMax), 16) || y >= sx(r(ScissorMax) >> 16, 16))
3195 return true;
3196 }
3197 if (r(ScissorMode) & 2)
3198 {
3199 const int64_t screen_x = x + (m_job.setup ? sx(r(WindowOrigin), 12) : 0);
3200 const int64_t screen_y = y +
3201 (m_job.setup ? sx(r(WindowOrigin) >> 16, 12) : 0);
3202 if (screen_x < 0 || screen_y < 0 ||
3203 screen_x >= static_cast<int32_t>(r(ScreenSize) & 0xffff) ||
3204 screen_y >= static_cast<int32_t>(r(ScreenSize) >> 16))
3205 return true;
3206 }
3207 if (packed_limits && (r(FBReadMode) & Packed))
3208 {
3209 const int32_t start = sx(r(PackedDataLimits) >> 16, 12);
3210 const int32_t end = sx(r(PackedDataLimits), 12);
3211 // Drivers may specify the two native-pixel edges in either order.
3212 if (x < std::min(start, end) || x >= std::max(start, end))
3213 return true;
3214 }
3215 return false;
3216}
3217
3218uint32_t CPermedia2::pixel_read(int64_t address, unsigned bytes) const
3219{
3220 uint32_t value = 0;
3221 if (address < 0 || address > int64_t(VramSize - bytes))
3222 return 0;
3223 for (unsigned i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
3224 value |= uint32_t(m_vram[static_cast<size_t>(address) + i]) << (8 * i);
3225 return value;
3226}
3227
3228void CPermedia2::pixel_write(
3229 int64_t address, unsigned bytes, uint32_t value, uint32_t sw, uint32_t hw)
3230{
3231 if (address < 0 || address > int64_t(VramSize - bytes))
3232 return;
3233 for (unsigned i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
3234 {
3235 const auto addr = static_cast<uint32_t>(address) + i;
3236 const uint8_t mask = uint8_t(
3237 (sw >> (i * 8)) & (hw >> ((addr & 3) * 8)) &
3238 (r(FramebufferWriteMask) >> ((addr & 3) * 8)));
3239 m_vram[addr] =
3240 uint8_t((m_vram[addr] & ~mask) | ((value >> (i * 8)) & mask));
3241 }
3242}
3243
3244uint32_t CPermedia2::logical_op(unsigned op, uint32_t s, uint32_t d)
3245{
3246 switch (op & 15)
3247 {
3248 case 0:
3249 return 0;
3250 case 1:
3251 return s & d;
3252 case 2:
3253 return s & ~d;
3254 case 3:
3255 return s;
3256 case 4:
3257 return ~s & d;
3258 case 5:
3259 return d;
3260 case 6:
3261 return s ^ d;
3262 case 7:
3263 return s | d;
3264 case 8:
3265 return ~(s | d);
3266 case 9:
3267 return ~(s ^ d);
3268 case 10:
3269 return ~d;
3270 case 11:
3271 return s | ~d;
3272 case 12:
3273 return ~s;
3274 case 13:
3275 return ~s | d;
3276 case 14:
3277 return ~(s & d);
3278 default:
3279 return 0xffffffffu;
3280 }
3281}
3282
3283uint32_t CPermedia2::format_color(uint32_t v, int32_t x, int32_t y) const
3284{
3285 if (!(r(DitherMode) & 1))
3286 return v;
3287 const uint32_t fmt =
3288 ((r(DitherMode) >> 2) & 15) | ((r(DitherMode) >> 12) & 16);
3289 if (fmt == 14)
3290 return v & 255; // Color index, not a RAMDAC ColorMode enum
3291 const bool rgb = (r(DitherMode) & 0x400) != 0;
3292 // Internal color is AABBGGRR. RGB framebuffer order puts red in the
3293 // higher channel; BGR puts it in the lower one (SLAU011A, p. 7-36).
3294 const uint32_t red = v & 255, green = (v >> 8) & 255,
3295 blue = (v >> 16) & 255;
3296 uint32_t low = rgb ? blue : red, high = rgb ? red : blue;
3297 uint32_t mid = green;
3298 if (r(DitherMode) & 2)
3299 {
3300 // Ordered color reduction adds the position-dependent fraction before
3301 // clamping and truncation. XY offsets select window-relative phase
3302 // (SLAU011A, section 4.14). The 2x2 pattern follows the GLINT color
3303 // formatter described in the 300SX architecture manual, section 13.1.1.
3304 static const uint8_t dither[2][2] = {{0, 2}, {3, 1}};
3305 const uint32_t dx = (uint32_t(x) + (r(DitherMode) >> 6)) & 1;
3306 const uint32_t dy = (uint32_t(y) + (r(DitherMode) >> 8)) & 1;
3307 const uint32_t fraction = dither[dy][dx];
3308 low = std::min<uint32_t>(255, low + fraction * 2);
3309 mid = std::min<uint32_t>(255, mid + fraction);
3310 high = std::min<uint32_t>(255, high + fraction * 2);
3311 }
3312 uint32_t alpha = v >> 24;
3313 if (r(DitherMode) & 0x1000)
3314 alpha = 0;
3315 if (r(DitherMode) & 0x2000)
3316 alpha = 0xf8;
3317 switch (fmt)
3318 {
3319 case 0:
3320 return low | (green << 8) | (high << 16) | (alpha << 24);
3321 case 1:
3322 return (low >> 3) | ((green >> 3) << 5) | ((high >> 3) << 10) |
3323 ((alpha >> 7) << 15);
3324 case 2:
3325 return (low >> 4) | ((green >> 4) << 4) | ((high >> 4) << 8) |
3326 ((alpha >> 4) << 12);
3327 case 16:
3328 return (low >> 3) | ((mid >> 2) << 5) | ((high >> 3) << 11);
3329 default:
3330 return 0; // start_render rejects unsupported active formats
3331 }
3332}
3333
3334bool CPermedia2::emit_pixel(int32_t x, int32_t y, uint32_t value, bool raw)
3335{
3336 // Packed-copy edge limits do not trim block-write fragments. The rasterizer
3337 // defines their native-pixel area; ordinary scissoring still applies.
3338 if (clipped(x, y, !(m_job.command & FastFill)))
3339 return false;
3340 if ((m_job.command & 1) && (r(AreaStippleMode) & 1))
3341 {
3342 // Permedia 2 stipples are always 8x8 (SLAU011A, pp. 7-8..7-10).
3343 // Only three bits of each offset are used. Reserved and unused mode
3344 // fields are retained without effect, including those written by NT4.
3345 const uint32_t mode = r(AreaStippleMode);
3346 uint32_t ax = (uint32_t(x) + (mode >> 7)) & 7,
3347 ay = (uint32_t(y) + (mode >> 12)) & 7;
3348 if (mode & (1u << 18))
3349 ax = 7 - ax;
3350 if (mode & (1u << 19))
3351 ay = 7 - ay;
3352 bool bit = ((r(AreaStipplePattern0 + ay * 8) >> ax) & 1) != 0;
3353 if (mode & (1u << 17))
3354 bit = !bit;
3355 if (!bit)
3356 {
3357 if (mode & (1u << 20))
3358 {
3359 value = r(Texel0);
3360 raw = true;
3361 }
3362 else
3363 return false;
3364 }
3365 }
3366 // Depth/local-buffer updates precede the optional framebuffer write.
3367 // Block fragments bypass both units (SLAU011A, section 4.4.6).
3368 if (!(m_job.command & FastFill) && !depth_test(x, y))
3369 return false;
3370 if (!(r(FBWriteMode) & 1))
3371 return false;
3372 const unsigned bytes = render_bytes();
3373 const int64_t sign = (r(FBWriteConfig) & 0x10000) ? -1 : 1;
3374 int64_t offset = int64_t(y) * pitch_from_products(r(FBWriteConfig)) *
3375 sign + x;
3376 if (r(FBWriteConfig) & 0x40000)
3377 {
3378 if (x < 0 || y < 0)
3379 {
3380 report("FB_PATCH_ADDRESS", FBWriteConfig, r(FBWriteConfig),
3381 "Negative Subpatch host coordinates are not implemented", true);
3382 return false;
3383 }
3384 // Subpatch stores 32x32 pixels in interleaved X/Y order. Complete
3385 // tile rows retain the configured pitch; the window base and pixel
3386 // offset are applied after converting the local coordinates.
3387 uint32_t within = 0;
3388 for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < 5; ++bit)
3389 {
3390 within |= ((uint32_t(x) >> bit) & 1) << (2 * bit);
3391 within |= ((uint32_t(y) >> bit) & 1) << (2 * bit + 1);
3392 }
3393 offset = int64_t(uint32_t(y) & ~31u) *
3394 pitch_from_products(r(FBWriteConfig)) +
3395 int64_t(uint32_t(x) & ~31u) * 32 + within;
3396 }
3397 const int64_t pixel = int64_t(r(FBWindowBase)) + offset + r(FBPixelOffset);
3398 const int64_t address = pixel * bytes;
3399 if (address < 0 || address > int64_t(VramSize - bytes))
3400 {
3401 if (!m_warned[FBWindowBase / 8])
3402 {
3403 m_warned[FBWindowBase / 8] = true;
3404 report(
3405 "DRAW_RANGE",
3406 FBWindowBase,
3407 uint32_t(pixel),
3408 "Out-of-VRAM fragment discarded; electrical aliasing "
3409 "unmodeled");
3410 }
3411 return false;
3412 }
3413 if (!(m_job.command & FastFill) && (r(LogicalOpMode) & 0x20))
3414 {
3415 // Native fragments use the low pixel of FBWriteData, as with data
3416 // produced by the Logic Op unit. Packed fragments select a byte lane
3417 // from its complete word. FastFill uses FBBlockColor instead.
3418 value = r(FBWriteData);
3419 if (r(FBReadMode) & Packed)
3420 value >>= (uint32_t(address) & 3) * 8;
3421 }
3422 else if (!raw)
3423 value = format_color(value, x, y);
3424 const uint32_t old = pixel_read(address, bytes);
3425 if (!(m_job.command & FastFill))
3426 {
3427 const uint32_t destination =
3428 (r(FBReadMode) & ReadDestination) ? old : 0;
3429 if (r(LogicalOpMode) & 1)
3430 value =
3431 logical_op((r(LogicalOpMode) >> 1) & 15, value, destination);
3432 value = (value & r(FBSoftwareWriteMask)) |
3433 (destination & ~r(FBSoftwareWriteMask));
3434 }
3435 pixel_write(address, bytes, value, 0xffffffffu, r(FBHardwareWriteMask));
3436 return true;
3437}
3438
3439// Display and video timing
3440
3441uint32_t CPermedia2::scanout_color(uint32_t raw, uint8_t format) const
3442{
3443 return scanout_color(raw, format, m_dac, m_palette, r(PixelMask));
3444}
3445
3446uint32_t CPermedia2::scanout_color(uint32_t raw, uint8_t format,
3447 const std::array<uint8_t, 256>& dac,
3448 const std::array<uint8_t, 768>& palette, uint32_t pixel_mask)
3449{
3450 uint32_t red = 0, green = 0, blue = 0;
3451 const bool rgb = (dac[DACColorMode] & 0x20) != 0;
3452 auto pal = [&](uint32_t index, unsigned lane) -> uint32_t {
3453 uint32_t v = palette[(index & 255) * 3 + lane];
3454 if (!(dac[DACMiscControl] & 2))
3455 {
3456 v &= 63;
3457 v = (v << 2) | (v >> 4);
3458 }
3459 return v;
3460 };
3461 if (format == 0)
3462 {
3463 const uint32_t index = raw & pixel_mask & 255;
3464 return 0xff000000u | (pal(index, 0) << 16) | (pal(index, 1) << 8) |
3465 pal(index, 2);
3466 }
3467 // RGB places red at the high end; BGR places it at the low end. The 3:3:2
3468 // format keeps R/G/B widths of 3/3/2 in both orders (SLAU011A, Table 3-1).
3469 switch (format)
3470 {
3471 case 1:
3472 red = ((raw >> (rgb ? 5 : 0)) & 7) * 255 / 7;
3473 green = ((raw >> (rgb ? 2 : 3)) & 7) * 255 / 7;
3474 blue = ((raw >> (rgb ? 0 : 6)) & 3) * 255 / 3;
3475 break;
3476 case 4:
3477 red = ((raw >> (rgb ? 10 : 0)) & 31) * 255 / 31;
3478 green = ((raw >> 5) & 31) * 255 / 31;
3479 blue = ((raw >> (rgb ? 0 : 10)) & 31) * 255 / 31;
3480 break;
3481 case 5:
3482 red = ((raw >> (rgb ? 8 : 0)) & 15) * 17;
3483 green = ((raw >> 4) & 15) * 17;
3484 blue = ((raw >> (rgb ? 0 : 8)) & 15) * 17;
3485 break;
3486 case 6:
3487 red = ((raw >> (rgb ? 11 : 0)) & 31) * 255 / 31;
3488 green = ((raw >> 5) & 63) * 255 / 63;
3489 blue = ((raw >> (rgb ? 0 : 11)) & 31) * 255 / 31;
3490 break;
3491 case 8:
3492 case 9:
3493 red = (raw >> (rgb ? 16 : 0)) & 255;
3494 green = (raw >> 8) & 255;
3495 blue = (raw >> (rgb ? 0 : 16)) & 255;
3496 break;
3497 default:
3498 return 0xff000000u;
3499 }
3500 // RDColorMode bit 7 selects TrueColor palette bypass. With it clear, packed
3501 // components address the LUT. CI8 always uses the indexed path above.
3502 if (!(dac[DACColorMode] & 0x80))
3503 {
3504 red = pal(red, 0);
3505 green = pal(green, 1);
3506 blue = pal(blue, 2);
3507 }
3508 return 0xff000000u | (red << 16) | (green << 8) | blue;
3509}
3510
3511CPermedia2::Scanout::Scanout() : m_pixels(VramSize)
3512{
3513}
3514
3515void CPermedia2::capture_scanout(Scanout& snapshot) const
3516{
3517 snapshot.m_width = snapshot.m_height = 0;
3518 if (!(r(VideoControl) & 1))
3519 return;
3520 const uint8_t format = m_dac[DACColorMode] & 15;
3521 unsigned bytes = 0;
3522 switch (format)
3523 {
3524 case 0:
3525 case 1:
3526 bytes = 1;
3527 break;
3528 case 4:
3529 case 5:
3530 case 6:
3531 bytes = 2;
3532 break;
3533 case 8:
3534 bytes = 4;
3535 break;
3536 case 9:
3537 bytes = 3;
3538 break;
3539 default:
3540 return;
3541 }
3542 const uint32_t total = (r(HTotal) & 0x7ff) + 1, blank = r(HbEnd) & 0x7ff;
3543 const uint32_t vtotal = (r(VTotal) & 0x7ff) + 1, vblank = r(VbEnd) & 0x7ff;
3544 if (total <= blank || vtotal <= vblank)
3545 return;
3546 const uint32_t wordbytes = (r(VideoControl) & 0x10000) ? 8u : 4u;
3547 const uint32_t width = (total - blank) * wordbytes / bytes;
3548 const uint32_t height = vtotal - vblank;
3549 const uint32_t stride = (r(ScreenStride) & 0x1fff) * 8;
3550 const uint64_t base = uint64_t(m_active_screen_base) * 8;
3551 if (!stride || !width || width > 4096 || height > 2048 ||
3552 base + uint64_t(height - 1) * stride + uint64_t(width) * bytes >
3553 VramSize)
3554 return;
3555 snapshot.m_width = width;
3556 snapshot.m_height = height;
3557 snapshot.m_bytes = bytes;
3558 snapshot.m_dac = m_dac;
3559 snapshot.m_palette = m_palette;
3560 snapshot.m_pixel_mask = r(PixelMask);
3561 snapshot.m_cursor = m_cursor;
3562 snapshot.m_cursor_colors = m_cursor_colors;
3563 snapshot.m_cursor_x = uint16_t(((r(CursorXHigh) & 255) << 8) |
3564 (r(CursorXLow) & 255));
3565 snapshot.m_cursor_y = uint16_t(((r(CursorYHigh) & 255) << 8) |
3566 (r(CursorYLow) & 255));
3567 const uint32_t row_bytes = width * bytes;
3568 snapshot.m_stride = std::min(stride, row_bytes);
3569 if (stride <= row_bytes)
3570 {
3571 // Adjacent or overlapping rows contain no invisible padding. Copy their
3572 // union once, retaining overlap so even these modes fit the 8 MiB buffer.
3573 std::memcpy(snapshot.m_pixels.data(), m_vram.data() + size_t(base),
3574 size_t(height - 1) * stride + row_bytes);
3575 }
3576 else
3577 {
3578 // Pack only visible bytes; row padding and offscreen storage are not
3579 // needed for conversion. The reusable destination never grows here.
3580 for (uint32_t y = 0; y < height; ++y)
3581 std::memcpy(snapshot.m_pixels.data() + size_t(y) * row_bytes,
3582 m_vram.data() + size_t(base) + size_t(y) * stride, row_bytes);
3583 }
3584}
3585
3586CPermedia2::Frame CPermedia2::scanout(const Scanout& snapshot, bool include_cursor)
3587{
3588 Frame f;
3589 f.width = snapshot.m_width;
3590 f.height = snapshot.m_height;
3591 if (!f.width || !f.height)
3592 return f;
3593 const unsigned bytes = snapshot.m_bytes;
3594 const uint8_t format = snapshot.m_dac[DACColorMode] & 15;
3595 f.argb.resize(size_t(f.width) * f.height);
3596 for (uint32_t y = 0; y < f.height; ++y)
3597 for (uint32_t x = 0; x < f.width; ++x)
3598 {
3599 const uint8_t* pixel = snapshot.m_pixels.data() +
3600 size_t(y) * snapshot.m_stride + size_t(x) * bytes;
3601 uint32_t raw = 0;
3602 for (unsigned i = 0; i < bytes; ++i)
3603 raw |= uint32_t(pixel[i]) << (8 * i);
3604 f.argb[size_t(y) * f.width + x] = scanout_color(raw, format,
3605 snapshot.m_dac, snapshot.m_palette, snapshot.m_pixel_mask);
3606 }
3607 if (include_cursor)
3608 composite_cursor(f, snapshot);
3609 return f;
3610}
3611
3612CPermedia2::Frame CPermedia2::scanout(bool include_cursor) const
3613{
3614 Scanout snapshot;
3615 capture_scanout(snapshot);
3616 return scanout(snapshot, include_cursor);
3617}
3618
3619void CPermedia2::composite_cursor(Frame& frame, const Scanout& snapshot)
3620{
3621 const uint8_t control = snapshot.m_dac[DACCursorControl];
3622 const unsigned mode = control & 3;
3623 if (mode == 0)
3624 return;
3625
3626 // HRM sections 5.6-5.8: two 64x64 one-bit planes, eight bytes per row,
3627 // most-significant bit first. Small cursors select a quadrant in each plane.
3628 const bool large = (control & 0x40) != 0;
3629 const unsigned size = large ? 64 : 32;
3630 const unsigned selected = (control >> 4) & 3;
3631 const unsigned pattern_base =
3632 large ? 0 : (selected & 1) * 4 + (selected >> 1) * 256;
3633 // Position registers specify the selected cursor's bottom-right corner.
3634 const int origin_x = int(snapshot.m_cursor_x) - int(size);
3635 const int origin_y = int(snapshot.m_cursor_y) - int(size);
3636
3637 // Table 5.4 indexes the planes as (plane1 << 1) | plane0. Zero means
3638 // transparent and -1 means complement; colors occupy slots1-3 (slot0 unused).
3639 static const int8_t colors[3][4] = {
3640 {0, 1, 2, 3}, {1, 2, 0, -1}, {0, 0, 1, 2}};
3641 uint32_t argb[4]{};
3642 for (unsigned i = 1; i < 4; ++i)
3643 {
3644 // Cursor colors are always 24-bit RGB, independent of main-palette width,
3645 // PixelMask, and the framebuffer's pixel format or component ordering.
3646 argb[i] = 0xff000000u | (uint32_t(snapshot.m_cursor_colors[i * 3]) << 16) |
3647 (uint32_t(snapshot.m_cursor_colors[i * 3 + 1]) << 8) |
3648 snapshot.m_cursor_colors[i * 3 + 2];
3649 }
3650 for (unsigned cy = 0; cy < size; ++cy)
3651 {
3652 const int y = origin_y + int(cy);
3653 if (y < 0 || uint32_t(y) >= frame.height)
3654 continue;
3655 for (unsigned cx = 0; cx < size; ++cx)
3656 {
3657 const int x = origin_x + int(cx);
3658 if (x < 0 || uint32_t(x) >= frame.width)
3659 continue;
3660 const unsigned address = pattern_base + cy * 8 + cx / 8;
3661 const unsigned shift = 7 - (cx & 7);
3662 const unsigned planes = ((snapshot.m_cursor[address] >> shift) & 1) |
3663 (((snapshot.m_cursor[address + 0x200] >> shift) & 1) << 1);
3664 const int color = colors[mode - 1][planes];
3665 uint32_t& pixel = frame.argb[size_t(y) * frame.width + unsigned(x)];
3666 if (color > 0)
3667 pixel = argb[color];
3668 else if (color < 0)
3669 pixel ^=
3670 0x00ffffffu; // Preserve the host frame's opaque alpha channel.
3671 }
3672 }
3673}
3674
3675void CPermedia2::write_ppm(std::ostream& out, const Frame& f)
3676{
3677 if (!f.width || !f.height || f.argb.size() != size_t(f.width) * f.height)
3678 throw std::invalid_argument("Cannot export empty/invalid scanout");
3679 out << "P6\n" << f.width << ' ' << f.height << "\n255\n";
3680 for (const uint32_t p : f.argb)
3681 {
3682 const char rgb[3] = {char(p >> 16), char(p >> 8), char(p)};
3683 out.write(rgb, 3);
3684 }
3685 if (!out)
3686 throw std::runtime_error("PPM write failed");
3687}
3688
3689void CPermedia2::advance_scanlines(uint32_t lines)
3690{
3691 // Explicitly virtual scanlines, not PLL cycles. Caller controls time.
3692 if (!(r(VideoControl) & 1))
3693 return;
3694 const uint32_t total = (r(VTotal) & 0x7ff) + 1;
3695 for (uint32_t n = 0; n < lines; ++n)
3696 {
3697 r(LineCount) = (r(LineCount) + 1) % total;
3698 if (r(LineCount) == 0)
3699 {
3700 ++m_frame_number;
3701 r(IntFlags) |= IRQ_VBLANK;
3702 m_active_screen_base = r(ScreenBase);
3703 r(VideoControl) &= ~0x80u;
3704 }
3705 if (r(LineCount) == (r(InterruptLine) & 0x7ff))
3706 r(IntFlags) |= IRQ_SCANLINE;
3707 }
3708 update_irq();
3709}

3711// Device lifecycle
3712
3713CPermedia2::CPermedia2() : CPermedia2(Options{})
3714{
3715}
3716
3717CPermedia2::CPermedia2(const Options& o) : m_options(o), m_vram(VramSize)
3718{
3719 if (o.input_fifo_entries != 32 && o.input_fifo_entries != 256 &&
3720 o.input_fifo_entries != 258)
3721 throw std::invalid_argument(
3722 "Permedia2 input FIFO capacity must be 32, 256 or 258");
3723 dac_map(m_dac_map);
3724 reset();
3725}
3726
3727void CPermedia2::reset(bool clear_vram)
3728{
3729 // PCI configuration belongs to the board wrapper and is NOT software-reset here.
3730 m_regs.fill(0);
3731 m_texel_lut.fill(0);
3732 m_texel_lut_read = 0;
3733 m_dac.fill(0);
3734 m_palette.fill(0);
3735 m_cursor.fill(0);
3736 m_cursor_colors.fill(0);
3737 m_input.clear();
3738 m_output.clear();
3739 m_decoder = {};
3740 m_job = {};
3741 m_warned.fill(false);
3742 m_unknown_reported.fill(false);
3743 m_palette_w = m_palette_r = m_cursor_color_pos = m_cursor_pos = 0;
3744 m_active_screen_base = m_dma_cursor = m_out_dma_cursor = 0;
3745 m_relative_offset = 0;
3746 m_frame_number = m_wait_frame = 0;
3747 m_waiting_frame = m_halted = false;
3748 m_last_fault.clear();
3749 r(ChipConfig) = m_options.chip_config;
3750 r(MemControl) = m_options.mem_control;
3751 r(MemConfig) = m_options.mem_config;
3752 r(BootAddress) = 0x31;
3753 r(VSConfiguration) = 0x1f0;
3754 r(FifoControl) = 0x1010;
3755 r(BypassWriteMask) = r(FramebufferWriteMask) = 0xffffffffu;
3756 r(FBSoftwareWriteMask) = r(FBHardwareWriteMask) = 0xffffffffu;
3757 r(PixelMask) = 255;
3758 if (clear_vram)
3759 std::fill(m_vram.begin(), m_vram.end(), uint8_t(0));
3760 if (m_irq)
3761 {
3762 m_irq = false;
3763 if (m_irq_callback)
3764 m_irq_callback(false);
3765 }
3766}
3767
3768void CPermedia2::report(
3769 const char* code, uint32_t a, uint32_t v, const char* message, bool fatal)
3770{
3771 if (fatal)
3772 {
3773 m_halted = true;
3774 m_last_fault = std::string(code) + ": " + message;
3775 }
3776 if (m_diagnostic)
3777 m_diagnostic(Diagnostic{code, message, a, v, fatal});
3778}
3779
3780// Snapshots
3781
3782static void put32(std::ostream& s, uint32_t v)
3783{
3784 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
3785 s.put(char(v >> (i * 8)));
3786}
3787
3788static void put64(std::ostream& s, uint64_t v)
3789{
3790 put32(s, uint32_t(v));
3791 put32(s, uint32_t(v >> 32));
3792}
3793
3794static uint32_t get32(std::istream& s)
3795{
3796 uint32_t v = 0;
3797 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
3798 {
3799 const int c = s.get();
3800 if (c < 0)
3801 throw std::runtime_error("Truncated PM2 snapshot");
3802 v |= uint32_t(c) << (8 * i);
3803 }
3804 return v;
3805}
3806
3807static uint64_t get64(std::istream& s)
3808{
3809 const uint32_t lo = get32(s), hi = get32(s);
3810 return lo | (uint64_t(hi) << 32);
3811}
3812
3813static int64_t signed64(uint64_t v)
3814{
3815 return v <= uint64_t(INT64_MAX) ? int64_t(v)
3816 : (-1 - static_cast<int64_t>(~v));
3817}
3818
3819static int32_t signed32(uint32_t v)
3820{
3821 return v <= uint32_t(INT32_MAX) ? int32_t(v)
3822 : (-1 - static_cast<int32_t>(~v));
3823}
3824
3825static bool getbool(std::istream& s)
3826{
3827 const auto v = get32(s);
3828 if (v > 1)
3829 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid snapshot Boolean");
3830 return v != 0;
3831}
3832
3833static void require(bool p)
3834{
3835 if (!p)
3836 throw std::runtime_error("Invalid PM2 snapshot state");
3837}
3838
3839void CPermedia2::SaveState(std::ostream& s) const
3840{
3841 s.write("PM2SNP01", 8);
3842 put32(s, 6);
3843 put32(s, VramSize);
3844 put32(s, m_options.chip_config);
3845 put32(s, m_options.mem_control);
3846 put32(s, m_options.mem_config);
3847 put32(s, m_options.input_fifo_entries);
3848 for (const auto v : m_regs)
3849 put32(s, v);
3850 for (const auto* a : {&m_dac})
3851 s.write(
3852 reinterpret_cast<const char*>(a->data()),
3853 static_cast<std::streamsize>(a->size()));
3854 s.write(
3855 reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_palette.data()),
3856 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_palette.size()));
3857 s.write(
3858 reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_cursor_colors.data()),
3859 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_cursor_colors.size()));
3860 s.write(
3861 reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_cursor.data()),
3862 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_cursor.size()));
3863 put32(s, m_palette_w);
3864 put32(s, m_palette_r);
3865 put32(s, m_cursor_color_pos);
3866 put32(s, m_cursor_pos);
3867 put32(s, m_active_screen_base);
3868 put32(s, m_dma_cursor);
3869 put32(s, uint32_t(m_relative_offset));
3870 put64(s, m_frame_number);
3871 put64(s, m_wait_frame);
3872 put32(s, m_halted);
3873 put32(s, m_waiting_frame);
3874 put32(s, m_decoder.mode);
3875 put32(s, m_decoder.tag);
3876 put32(s, m_decoder.remaining);
3877 put32(s, m_decoder.mask);
3878 put32(s, m_job.active);
3879 put32(s, m_job.command);
3880 put32(s, m_job.primitive);
3881 put32(s, m_job.row);
3882 put32(s, m_job.col);
3883 put32(s, m_job.rows);
3884 put32(s, m_job.columns);
3885 put32(s, m_job.payload);
3886 put32(s, m_job.payload_left);
3887 put32(s, m_job.payload_tag);
3888 put32(s, uint32_t(m_job.origin_x));
3889 put32(s, uint32_t(m_job.origin_y));
3890 for (const int64_t v :
3891 {m_job.xdom, m_job.xsub, m_job.y, m_job.dxdom, m_job.dxsub, m_job.dy})
3892 put64(s, uint64_t(v));
3893 for (const auto* a : {&m_job.color, &m_job.dcolor_dx, &m_job.dcolor_dy})
3894 for (const int64_t v : *a)
3895 put64(s, uint64_t(v));
3896 put32(s, m_job.alpha);
3897 put32(s, m_job.interpolation);
3898 for (const int64_t v : {m_job.z, m_job.dzdx, m_job.dzdy})
3899 put64(s, uint64_t(v));
3900 put32(s, static_cast<uint32_t>(m_input.size()));
3901 for (const auto& c : m_input)
3902 {
3903 put32(s, c.address);
3904 put32(s, c.value);
3905 }
3906 put32(s, static_cast<uint32_t>(m_output.size()));
3907 for (const auto& o : m_output)
3908 {
3909 put32(s, o.value);
3910 put32(s, o.interrupt);
3911 }
3912 put32(s, static_cast<uint32_t>(m_last_fault.size()));
3913 s.write(
3914 m_last_fault.data(), static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_last_fault.size()));
3915 s.write(
3916 reinterpret_cast<const char*>(m_vram.data()),
3917 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_vram.size()));
3918 // The latched output DMA cursor differs from the independently
3919 // programmable OutDMAAddress register.
3920 put32(s, m_out_dma_cursor);
3921 put32(s, m_job.setup);
3922 put32(s, m_job.knee_rows);
3923 put64(s, uint64_t(m_job.knee_xsub));
3924 put64(s, uint64_t(m_job.knee_dxsub));
3925 for (const uint32_t value : m_texel_lut)
3926 put32(s, value);
3927 put32(s, m_texel_lut_read);
3928 if (!s)
3929 throw std::runtime_error("PM2 snapshot write failed");
3930}
3931
3932void CPermedia2::restore_state(std::istream& s)
3933{
3934 char magic[8]{};
3935 s.read(magic, 8);
3936 require(std::string(magic, 8) == "PM2SNP01");
3937 require(get32(s) == 6);
3938 require(get32(s) == VramSize);
3939 m_options.chip_config = get32(s);
3940 m_options.mem_control = get32(s);
3941 m_options.mem_config = get32(s);
3942 m_options.input_fifo_entries = get32(s);
3943 require(
3944 m_options.input_fifo_entries == 32 ||
3945 m_options.input_fifo_entries == 256 ||
3946 m_options.input_fifo_entries == 258);
3947 for (auto& v : m_regs)
3948 v = get32(s);
3949 s.read(
3950 reinterpret_cast<char*>(m_dac.data()),
3951 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_dac.size()));
3952 s.read(
3953 reinterpret_cast<char*>(m_palette.data()),
3954 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_palette.size()));
3955 s.read(
3956 reinterpret_cast<char*>(m_cursor_colors.data()),
3957 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_cursor_colors.size()));
3958 s.read(
3959 reinterpret_cast<char*>(m_cursor.data()),
3960 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_cursor.size()));
3961 m_palette_w = get32(s);
3962 m_palette_r = get32(s);
3963 m_cursor_color_pos = get32(s);
3964 m_cursor_pos = get32(s);
3965 m_active_screen_base = get32(s);
3966 m_dma_cursor = get32(s);
3967 m_relative_offset = signed32(get32(s));
3968 m_frame_number = get64(s);
3969 m_wait_frame = get64(s);
3970 m_halted = getbool(s);
3971 m_waiting_frame = getbool(s);
3972 m_decoder.mode = get32(s);
3973 m_decoder.tag = get32(s);
3974 m_decoder.remaining = get32(s);
3975 m_decoder.mask = get32(s);
3976 m_job.active = getbool(s);
3977 m_job.command = get32(s);
3978 m_job.primitive = get32(s);
3979 m_job.row = get32(s);
3980 m_job.col = get32(s);
3981 m_job.rows = get32(s);
3982 m_job.columns = get32(s);
3983 m_job.payload = get32(s);
3984 m_job.payload_left = get32(s);
3985 m_job.payload_tag = get32(s);
3986 m_job.origin_x = signed32(get32(s));
3987 m_job.origin_y = signed32(get32(s));
3988 for (int64_t* p : {&m_job.xdom,
3989 &m_job.xsub,
3990 &m_job.y,
3991 &m_job.dxdom,
3992 &m_job.dxsub,
3993 &m_job.dy})
3994 *p = signed64(get64(s));
3995 for (auto* a : {&m_job.color, &m_job.dcolor_dx, &m_job.dcolor_dy})
3996 for (int64_t& v : *a)
3997 v = signed64(get64(s));
3998 m_job.alpha = get32(s);
3999 m_job.interpolation = get32(s);
4000 for (int64_t* p : {&m_job.z, &m_job.dzdx, &m_job.dzdy})
4001 *p = signed64(get64(s));
4002 for (const int64_t v : m_job.color)
4003 require(v >= -(int64_t(1) << 47) && v < (int64_t(1) << 47));
4004 for (const auto* a : {&m_job.dcolor_dx, &m_job.dcolor_dy})
4005 for (const int64_t v : *a)
4006 require(v >= -(int64_t(1) << 19) && v < (int64_t(1) << 19));
4007 require(m_job.alpha <= 255);
4008 require(m_job.interpolation <= 5);
4009 require(m_job.z >= -(int64_t(1) << 47) && m_job.z < (int64_t(1) << 47));
4010 for (const int64_t v : {m_job.dzdx, m_job.dzdy})
4011 require(v >= -(int64_t(1) << 27) && v < (int64_t(1) << 27));
4012 require(
4013 m_palette_w < 768 && m_palette_r < 768 && m_cursor_color_pos < 12 &&
4014 m_cursor_pos < 1024);
4015 require(
4016 m_active_screen_base <= 0x1fffff && m_relative_offset >= -4 &&
4017 m_relative_offset <= 3);
4018 require(
4019 m_decoder.mode <= 2 && m_decoder.tag < 1024 &&
4020 m_decoder.remaining <= 65536 && m_decoder.mask <= 65535);
4021 if (m_decoder.mode == 2)
4022 {
4023 unsigned count = 0;
4024 for (auto m = m_decoder.mask; m; m >>= 1)
4025 count += m & 1;
4026 require(count == m_decoder.remaining);
4027 }
4028 require(
4029 m_job.rows <= 65535 && m_job.columns <= 262140 &&
4030 m_job.payload_left <= 32);
4031 require(
4032 m_job.primitive == 0 || m_job.primitive == 0x40 ||
4033 m_job.primitive == 0x80 || m_job.primitive == 0xc0);
4034 if (m_job.active)
4035 require(
4036 m_job.row < m_job.rows &&
4037 (m_job.columns == 0 || m_job.col < m_job.columns));
4038 for (const auto v : {m_job.xdom, m_job.xsub, m_job.y})
4039 require(v >= -(int64_t(1) << 47) && v < (int64_t(1) << 47));
4040 for (const auto v : {m_job.dxdom, m_job.dxsub, m_job.dy})
4041 require(v >= INT32_MIN && v <= INT32_MAX);
4042 require(
4043 m_job.origin_x >= -131072 && m_job.origin_x <= 131068 &&
4044 m_job.origin_y >= -32768 && m_job.origin_y <= 32767);
4045 require(r(DMACount) <= 65535 && r(OutDMACount) <= 65535);
4046 const uint32_t n = get32(s);
4047 require(n <= m_options.input_fifo_entries);
4048 m_input.clear();
4049 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)
4050 {
4051 Command c;
4052 c.address = get32(s);
4053 c.value = get32(s);
4054 require(
4055 c.address >= 0x8000 && c.address < 0x10000 && (c.address & 7) == 0);
4056 m_input.push_back(c);
4057 }
4058 const uint32_t no = get32(s);
4059 require(no <= 8);
4060 m_output.clear();
4061 for (uint32_t i = 0; i < no; ++i)
4062 {
4063 Output o;
4064 o.value = get32(s);
4065 o.interrupt = getbool(s);
4066 m_output.push_back(o);
4067 }
4068 const uint32_t len = get32(s);
4069 require(len <= 4096);
4070 m_last_fault.resize(len);
4071 s.read(m_last_fault.data(), len);
4072 s.read(
4073 reinterpret_cast<char*>(m_vram.data()),
4074 static_cast<std::streamsize>(m_vram.size()));
4075 m_out_dma_cursor = get32(s);
4076 m_job.setup = getbool(s);
4077 m_job.knee_rows = get32(s);
4078 m_job.knee_xsub = signed64(get64(s));
4079 m_job.knee_dxsub = signed64(get64(s));
4080 for (uint32_t& value : m_texel_lut)
4081 value = get32(s);
4082 m_texel_lut_read = get32(s);
4083 require(m_texel_lut_read <= 255 && r(TexelLUTIndex) <= 255);
4084 for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
4085 require(r(TexelLUT0 + i * 8) == m_texel_lut[i]);
4086 require(m_job.knee_rows <= 4096);
4087 require(m_job.knee_xsub >= -134217728 && m_job.knee_xsub < 134217728);
4088 require(m_job.knee_dxsub >= -134217728 && m_job.knee_dxsub <= 134217726);
4089 if (m_job.setup)
4090 {
4091 require(m_job.primitive == PrimitiveTrapezoid);
4092 require(!(m_job.command & (FastFill | SyncHost | SyncMask | Texture)));
4093 require(m_job.payload_left == 0);
4094 require(m_job.active || m_job.knee_rows == 0);
4095 require(m_job.dy == 65536);
4096 require(m_job.y % 65536 == 0);
4097 for (const int64_t delta : {m_job.dxdom, m_job.dxsub, m_job.knee_dxsub})
4098 require(delta >= -134217728 && delta <= 134217726 && delta % 2 == 0);
4099 require((r(RasterizerMode) & 0x30) == 0);
4100 const int64_t width = std::abs(fixed_integer(m_job.xdom) -
4101 fixed_integer(m_job.xsub));
4102 require(width <= 65535 && m_job.columns == uint32_t(width));
4103 require(m_job.columns != 0 || m_job.col == 0);
4104 const int64_t first_steps = m_job.active ? m_job.rows - m_job.row - 1 : 0;
4105 const int64_t steps = first_steps + m_job.knee_rows;
4106 const auto coordinate_range = [](int64_t position, int64_t delta,
4107 int64_t count) {
4108 const int64_t end = position + delta * count;
4109 return position >= -134217728 && position < 134217728 &&
